For most jobs, use Rate around 0.2 to 0.8 Hz for gentle motion, Depth around 50 to 80% for audible effect, Cutoff around 500 Hz to 2 kHz for midrange presence, Order 3 to 5 for classic phasing, Spread around 30 to 70% for stereo width, and Mix from 30% for subtle enhancement to 100% for full effect.
kilohearts|khs phaser.name: kHs Phaser

kilohearts|khs pitch shifter.about: kHs Pitch Shifter is Kilohearts' real-time pitch shifter, which transposes audio up or down without changing its length. It is used for octave layers, harmony, detuned thickening and sound design on synths, vocals and drums. Pitch sets the transposition, Grain Size and Algorithm trade smoothness against artifacts, Jitter adds randomness to the grains for a smeared or chorused sound, Latency Compensation sets how its delay is handled, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
kilohearts|khs pitch shifter.name: kHs Pitch Shifter

kilohearts|khs resonator.about: kHs Resonator is a stereo Fx plugin that colours the input with a resonant, pitched tone that decays away. It is good for giving vocals, synths, and percussion formant-like body, emphasizing notes, or creating bell-like, metallic, or ringing accents. Pitch sets the resonant note, around A4 by default; match the source or choose a fifth or octave for musical colour. Decay controls how long the ring lasts: 1–30 ms for tight detail, 50–300 ms for a clear ring, 0.5–1 s for a long tail. Intensity sets strength, with 20–60 % natural, 80–100 % obvious; leave at 0 % only to disable. Timbre shifts from Saw, brighter and edgier, to Sqr, hollow and boxy. Mix blends the wet tone with the dry signal, around 30–70 % for balance.
kilohearts|khs resonator.name: kHs Resonator

kilohearts|khs reverb.about: kHs Reverb is a Kilohearts stereo reverb that adds reflections and tail to dry sound, making it feel placed in a room, plate, or hall. It suits vocals, drums, guitars, synths, and buses when you want space, depth, or a bigger stereo image. Key parameters: Size, 50-200%, sets room scale; use 70% for close rooms, 130% for plates, 180% for halls. Decay, 0.5-30.0s, sets tail length; 0.8s for small rooms, 2.0s for vocals, 4-6s for hall. Dampen, 0-100dB/s, darkens the tail; 40dB/s for tight rooms, 15-30dB/s for natural plates/halls. Width, 0-200%, controls stereo spread; 100-150% is common. Mix, 0-100%, dry/wet balance; 15-35% for most parts, 50-100% for full effect. Early, 0-100%, boosts initial reflections; 10-30% for presence.
kilohearts|khs reverb.name: kHs Reverb

kilohearts|khs reverser.about: kHs Reverser is a stereo reverse-delay plug-in that sends the input into a delay and returns the delayed copy backwards. It is good for reversed echoes, transitions, risers, and unusual textures on drums, synths, or vocals. Key parameters: Sync Mode, ms or sync; use sync for tempo-locked repeats or ms for exact times. Delay Time (ms) runs 10 ms to 5 s, with 200 ms useful for short reversed echoes. Delay Time (steps) is 1 to 64, and Delay Denominator is 4 to 32; in sync mode try 4 steps at 1/16. Mix is 0% to 100%; 50% is a balanced blend, 100% gives full reversed output. Crossfade is 0% to 100%; 10% lightly softens the delayed material, while higher values create gentler reverses and fades. Bypass is Off for normal use.
kilohearts|khs reverser.name: kHs Reverser

kilohearts|khs ring mod.about: kHs Ring Mod is Kilohearts' ring modulator, which multiplies the input by an oscillator (or a sidechain signal) to create metallic, bell-like or robotic inharmonic tones. It is used for sound design on synths, drums and vocals. Frequency sets the modulating oscillator's frequency, Spread offsets it between channels for stereo movement, Bias and Rectify change how the modulation is applied, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
kilohearts|khs ring mod.name: kHs Ring Mod

kilohearts|khs stereo.about: Kilohearts kHs Stereo is a stereo imaging effect that reshapes a signal’s left/right image, adding width, panning it, or emphasizing the center. It is good for widening pads, guitars, and drums, balancing stereo elements, tightening mono-ish leads, and preparing mixes for mono compatibility. Use Width for spread: 100 % is neutral, 110-150 % gives modest width, 300 % and higher is dramatic, 0 % is mono. Use Pan to move the image left or right; <C> keeps it centered, 10-30 % is a useful slight shift. Use Mid to control center content; 100 % is neutral, lower values thin the center for a wider sound, higher values strengthen it for mono-focused material.
kilohearts|khs stereo.name: kHs Stereo

kilohearts|khs tape stop.about: kHs Tape Stop is Kilohearts' tape-stop effect, which slows audio down to a halt with falling pitch like a tape machine or turntable losing power, and speeds it back up. It is used for transitions, drops and stutter-style breaks, usually automated. Play toggles between running and stopping, Stop Time sets how long the slow-down takes, Start Time sets how long it takes to come back up to speed, and Curve shapes the speed ramp.
kilohearts|khs tape stop.name: kHs Tape Stop

kilohearts|khs trance gate.about: kHs Trance Gate is a stereo effect that rhythmically opens and closes the audio, creating trance-style stutters and pumping. It is good for adding rhythmic cuts to basses, pads, synths, or drums, and for building trance-like movement in mixes. For common jobs, set Resolution to 1/32 for default detail, 1/16 or 1/8 for broader pulses; choose Pattern 1–8 to vary the gate rhythm; use Attack 5–20 ms for sharp onsets or 50–200 ms for smoother entry; use Decay 50–100 ms for stabs or 200–600 ms for longer swells; keep Sustain 100% for full open level or lower it to reduce gated volume; set Release 20 ms for tight cuts or 100–600 ms for tails; use Mix 100% for full effect or lower to blend with the dry sound.
kilohearts|khs trance gate.name: kHs Trance Gate

kilohearts|khs transient shaper.about: kHs Transient Shaper is Kilohearts' transient shaper, which boosts or reduces the attack and sustain parts of a sound independently of its level. It is used to add punch to or soften drums and plucked sounds, and to shorten or lengthen their tails, with an optional sidechain input. Attack and Sustain are the main controls (positive values emphasize, negative values reduce), Speed sets how quickly it responds, Pump adds a further envelope effect, and Clip limits the boosted peaks.
kilohearts|khs transient shaper.name: kHs Transient Shaper

krotos|dehumaniser.about: Dehumaniser is Krotos' creature and monster voice designer, which processes a voice through several combinable modules (pitch shifters, delayed pitch, granular, noise, spectral shift, ring modulation and scrub) to make it sound non-human. It is used for monster, creature, robot and alien voices in games, film and sound design. Each module has its own bypass, threshold, decay and level parameters (for example PShift1_bypass, PShift1_octaves, PShift1_semitones, DPitch1_feedback), and the Input_OutLev parameters set how much of the input goes to each module. It is easiest to start from a preset in its interface and adjust from there.
krotos|dehumaniser.name: Dehumaniser

krotos|reformer.about: Reformer is Krotos' free performable sound design effect, which analyzes the incoming audio and uses it to play back a loaded sound library (for example foley or animal sounds) in real time, following the input's dynamics and timbre. It is used to perform sound effects with a microphone or another sound rather than editing them by hand. The library is chosen in the plug-in interface; PlaybackSpeed changes the playback speed of the library material and DryWet blends the input with the output.
krotos|reformer.name: Reformer

krotos|reformer pro.about: Reformer Pro is Krotos' performable sound design effect, which analyzes the incoming audio and uses it to play back up to four loaded sound libraries in real time, following the input's dynamics and timbre. It is used to perform foley, creature, mechanical or other effects from a microphone or another recording. Libraries are loaded in the plug-in interface; padValueX and padValueY blend between the four layers, Volume0-3, PlaybackSpeed0-3 and mute_voice_0-3 control each layer, Threshold, Sensitivity, Attack and Decay set how each layer responds to the input, and MasterDryWet and MasterVolume set the overall output.
krotos|reformer pro.name: Reformer Pro

native instruments|bite.about: Bite is Native Instruments' bitcrusher from the Crush Pack, reducing sample rate and bit depth for digital grit and lo-fi textures. It is used on drums, synths, vocals and loops, from subtle aliasing to harsh digital destruction. Freq sets the reduced sample rate, Bit Depth sets the resolution, Jitter adds instability, Pre Flt and Post Flt filter before and after the crushing, Saturation and Crunch add further distortion, Dither smooths quantization, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|bite.name: Bite

native instruments|choral.about: Choral is Native Instruments' chorus from the Mod Pack, adding modulated, delayed voices to thicken and widen a sound, from subtle chorus to ensemble-style effects. It is used on synths, pads, guitars, keys and vocals. Mode chooses the chorus character, Voices sets how many delayed copies there are, Rate and Amount set the modulation, Delay sets the base delay, Width sets stereo spread, Feedback adds resonance, Scatter varies the voices, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|choral.name: Choral

native instruments|dirt.about: Dirt is Native Instruments' distortion from the Crush Pack, with two distortion stages (A and B) that can be run in series or parallel. It is used to add saturation, crunch or heavy distortion to drums, bass, synths and vocals. Each stage has Mode, Drive, Amount, Bias and Tilt controls (Drive A, Tilt B and so on), Routing sets how the stages combine, Safety A and Safety B limit extreme output, FX Trim sets the processed level, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|dirt.name: Dirt

native instruments|driver.about: Driver is Native Instruments' distortion and resonant filter effect, with an envelope follower and amplitude modulation that can move the filter and distortion. It is used for aggressive, moving tones on synths, bass and drums, and for auto-wah or rhythmic filter effects. Frequency, Resonance and Filter Type set the filter, Distortion and Color set the drive, Input and Output set levels, the F.ENV and D.ENV Modulation parameters let the input's envelope move the filter or distortion, and AM.Mode, Rate and the AM Modulation parameters add periodic modulation.
native instruments|driver.name: Driver

native instruments|flair.about: Flair is Native Instruments' flanger from the Mod Pack, which tunes its flanging to a pitch or chord so the comb-filter peaks sit on musical notes. It is used on pads, synths, drums and guitars for classic flanging, harmonic resonant sweeps or scanning effects. Pitch and Chord set the tuning of the resonances, Voices and Detune add more flanging voices, Feedback and Damping control resonance, Mode chooses the behavior, Rate and Amount set the modulation (LFO Sync locks it to tempo), Width sets stereo spread, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|flair.name: Flair

native instruments|fm8 fx.about: FM8 FX is the effect version of Native Instruments' FM8 synthesizer, which feeds incoming audio into FM8's operator matrix and built-in effects. Results depend heavily on the loaded preset and can range from mild coloring to radical FM-style transformation. The most predictable controls are the built-in effects, such as Overdrive: Drive, TubeAmp: Drive, and the Cabinet: Type and Cabinet: Size settings, each switched on with its On/Off parameter; Morph X and Morph Y and the Easy Edit parameters change the preset more broadly.
native instruments|fm8 fx.name: FM8 FX

native instruments|fm8 mfx.about: FM8 MFX is the effect version of Native Instruments' FM8 synthesizer, which feeds incoming audio into FM8's operator matrix and built-in effects. Results depend heavily on the loaded preset and can range from mild coloring to radical FM-style transformation. The most predictable controls are the built-in effects, such as Overdrive: Drive, TubeAmp: Drive, the Cabinet controls and ShelfEQ, each switched on with its On/Off parameter; Morph X and Morph Y and the Easy Edit parameters change the preset more broadly.
native instruments|fm8 mfx.name: FM8 MFX

native instruments|freak.about: Freak is Native Instruments' modulation-distortion effect from the Crush Pack, which modulates the input with an internal oscillator, a radio-noise source or a sidechain signal for ring-modulation and frequency-modulation style metallic, buzzy or broken tones. It is used for sound design on drums, synths, bass and vocals. FX Mode chooses the modulation source, Freq and Range set the modulator's frequency, Type, Harmonics and Feedback shape the character, Antifold controls foldback, Stereo offsets the channels, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|freak.name: Freak

native instruments|guitar rig 6.about: Guitar Rig 6 is Native Instruments' guitar amp and effects modeler, simulating amps, cabinets, pedals and studio effects in a configurable rack. It is used to turn DI guitar or bass into amped tones and to add creative effects to any source. Its sound depends entirely on the loaded preset or rack, and only the Macros Control 1 to Macros Control 16 parameters are meaningful from outside; the unnamed P017 and higher parameters should be left alone. Pick a preset in the plug-in first, then adjust the macros that preset assigns (often gain, tone or effect amount).
native instruments|guitar rig 6.name: Guitar Rig 6

native instruments|guitar rig 6 fx.about: Guitar Rig 6 FX is Native Instruments' guitar amp and effects modeler, simulating amps, cabinets, pedals and studio effects in a configurable rack. native instruments|guitar rig 7 mfx.name: Guitar Rig 7 MFX

native instruments|passive eq.about: Passive EQ is Native Instruments' emulation of the Manley Massive Passive tube equalizer, a four-band EQ with high-pass and low-pass filters, run as dual mono or mid/side. It is used for broad, musical tone shaping on mix buses, masters and individual tracks rather than surgical fixes. Each band has an On/Off switch, Gain, G.Mode (boost or cut), BW.Mode (shelf or bell), BW and Freq (for example L1 Gain, L1 Freq, LM1 Freq, HM1 Freq, H1 Gain); LP 1 and HP 1 are the filters and Gain 1 the output gain for channel 1, with matching parameters for channel 2 and Link to move both together.
native instruments|passive eq.name: Passive EQ

native instruments|phasis.about: Phasis is Native Instruments' phaser from the Mod Pack, sweeping a set of notches through the spectrum for classic to extreme phasing. It is used on synths, pads, guitars, drums and vocals for movement and width. Notches sets how many notches there are, Center and Spread set where they sit, Feedback adds resonance, Mode chooses the phaser character, Rate and Amount set the modulation (LFO Sync locks it to tempo), Stereo offsets the channels, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
native instruments|phasis.name: Phasis

native instruments|raum.about: Raum is Native Instruments' algorithmic reverb with three modes: Grounded for natural rooms, Airy for smooth, larger spaces, and Cosmic for long, modulated ambient tails. It is used on vocals, drums, pads and leads for anything from a short room to a huge ambient wash. Mode picks the character, Size and Decay set the space and tail length, Predelay separates the dry sound from the reverb (Sync locks it to tempo), Low Cut, High Cut and Damp shape the tone, Diffusion, Density and Modulation shape the texture, Freeze holds the tail, and Mix sets the wet/dry balance.
native instruments|raum.name: Raum

native instruments|rc 24.about: RC 24 is Native Instruments' algorithmic reverb modeled on a classic early digital studio reverb, adding room and hall ambience. It suits vocals, drums, keys and synths when you want a vintage, slightly grainy digital tail. Algorithm picks the space type, Bass and Mid set the decay time below and above Crossover, Predelay separates the dry sound from the tail, and Hi Cut and Rev Color darken or brighten it. Mix (with Mix Mode) sets the wet/dry balance; Depth, Intensity and Modulation add movement to the tail.
native instruments|rc 24.name: RC 24

native instruments|rc 48.about: RC 48 is Native Instruments' algorithmic reverb modeled on a classic high-end digital studio reverb, adding smooth room, hall and plate-like ambience. It suits vocals, drums, guitars and full mixes where a lush but controllable tail is wanted. Algorithm and Size set the space, Bass and Mid set decay times either side of Crossover, Predelay delays the tail onset, and Diffusion, Rev Damp and Hi Cut shape density and brightness. Mix (with Mix Mode) sets the wet/dry balance; the Echo L1-L6 and Echo D1-D6 controls add early echo taps.
native instruments|rc 48.name: RC 48

native instruments|replika.about: Replika is Native Instruments' stereo delay effect with several delay characters, from clean digital to diffused, filtered repeats. It is good for echoes, slapback, rhythmic repeats and ambient trails on vocals, guitars, synths and drums. Delay Time (with Time Mode for synced or free timing) sets the repeat spacing, Feedback the number of repeats and Mix the echo level. Mode selects the delay character, Stereo Mode the stereo behavior (e.g. ping-pong), LoCut and HiCut filter the repeats, and Saturation and Modulation add color and movement.
native instruments|replika.name: Replika

native instruments|replika xt.about: Replika XT is Native Instruments' extended stereo delay with several delay models, modulation, rhythmic pattern controls and ducking. It is good for slapback, synced rhythmic echoes, ping-pong and dub-style repeats, and ambient tails. Delay Time (with Time Mode and Host Sync) sets the spacing, Feedback the repeats and Mix the level; Delay Mode picks the delay character. LoCut and HiCut filter the repeats, Saturation adds grit, Mod Rate and Mod Depth add pitch wobble, Ping Pong and Width set the stereo image, and Ducker Amnt, Ducker Sens and Ducker Rls lower the echoes while the dry signal plays.
native instruments|replika xt.name: Replika XT

native instruments|solid bus comp.about: Solid Bus Comp is Native Instruments' emulation of a classic British console bus compressor, used for gluing groups and mixes. It suits drum buses, mix buses and stems where a few dB of gentle, cohesive gain reduction is wanted. Threshold and Ratio set the amount of compression, Attack and Release the timing (slower attack keeps transients), and Makeup or Output restore level. Dry blends in uncompressed signal for parallel compression, and SC Mode with SC Gain uses a sidechain input.
native instruments|solid bus comp.name: Solid Bus Comp

native instruments|solid dynamics.about: Solid Dynamics is Native Instruments' console-style dynamics processor combining a compressor/limiter with a gate/expander, modeled on a classic British channel strip. It is good for leveling vocals and bass, tightening drums and gating noise between hits. For compression use Threshold Comp, Ratio, Release Comp and Knee Type; for gating or expansion choose Mode and set Threshold G/E, Range and Release G/E. Output sets level, Dry allows parallel blending, and SC Mode with SC Gain uses an external sidechain.
native instruments|solid dynamics.name: Solid Dynamics

native instruments|solid eq.about: Solid EQ is Native Instruments' four-band console equalizer with high- and low-pass filters, modeled on a classic British channel EQ. It is good for broad tonal shaping and corrective cuts on vocals, drums, bass and instruments. HPF Freq and LPF Freq remove rumble and top-end hiss; LF and HF bands (Gain, Freq, with LF Mode/HF Mode for shelf or bell) shape lows and highs; LMF and HMF bands (Gain, Freq, Q) handle mud, boxiness and presence. EQ Mode switches between the two console EQ voicings.
native instruments|solid eq.name: Solid EQ

native instruments|supercharger gt.about: Supercharger GT is Native Instruments' tube-style compressor with built-in saturation and tone-shaping character controls. It is good for adding weight, density and drive to drums, bass, vocals and buses, from gentle squash to obvious pumping. Compression sets the amount, Attack and Release the timing, Saturation (with Saturation Mode) the drive, and Character (with Character Mode) the tonal emphasis. Mix blends with the dry signal for parallel use, Detector HP stops low end from driving the compressor, and Input Trim and Output set levels.
native instruments|supercharger gt.name: Supercharger GT

native instruments|transient master.about: Transient Master is Native Instruments' transient shaper that independently raises or lowers the attack and sustain portions of a sound, regardless of its level. It is good for adding punch to drums, softening harsh hits, or shortening and lengthening room and tail. Attack boosts or reduces the initial hit, Sustain boosts or reduces the body and tail; Gain sets output level, Limit prevents overs after boosting, and Smooth gives a softer, less aggressive response.
native instruments|transient master.name: Transient Master

native instruments|vari comp.about: Vari Comp is Native Instruments' variable-mu tube compressor emulation, known for smooth, gentle compression on buses and mastering. It suits mix buses, vocals and acoustic material where transparent glue is wanted rather than aggressive peak control. Thresh and Input set how hard it compresses, Attack and Recovery set timing, and Mode selects compress or limit behavior. Detector HP keeps low end from triggering gain reduction, Dry blends in uncompressed signal, and SC Mode with SC Gain uses an external sidechain.
native instruments|vari comp.name: Vari Comp

native instruments|vc 160.about: Native Instruments VC 160 is an analog-style stereo compressor that reduces dynamics by lowering level above Threshold. It suits vocals, drums, bass, and mix buses, and can duck one track under another when a sidechain is used. Key parameters: Threshold sets where gain reduction starts; lower it for more control. Compression sets the ratio; try 2-4:1 for natural glue, 6 or higher for pronounced squash. Output adds makeup gain to restore level. Dry blends in unprocessed signal; keep default -Inf dB for fully wet, raise it to taste for parallel. Detector HP filters the detection path, useful to ignore low end or emphasize mids. When using an external trigger, set SC Mode On and SC Gain around 0 dB, lowering it if detection is too aggressive. Use VU Mode Gain Reduction to watch control.
native instruments|vc 160.name: VC 160

native instruments|vc 2a.about: VC 2A is Native Instruments' emulation of a classic optical leveling amplifier, giving smooth, program-dependent compression. It is good for evening out vocals, bass and acoustic instruments without obvious pumping. Peak Reduction sets the amount of compression, Gain sets makeup level, and Mode switches between compress and limit behavior. Detector HP reduces the low-frequency response of the detector, Dry blends in uncompressed signal for parallel use, and SC Mode with SC Gain uses an external sidechain.
native instruments|vc 2a.name: VC 2A

native instruments|vc 76.about: VC 76 is Native Instruments' emulation of a classic FET compressor/limiter, known for fast, aggressive, punchy compression. It suits vocals, drums, bass and room mics, from controlled peak taming to heavy parallel crush. Input drives the compressor (more input means more compression), Output sets makeup level, Ratio chooses the compression ratio (including the all-buttons setting for extreme squash), and Attack and Release set timing; as on the original hardware, higher numbers are faster. Dry blends in uncompressed signal, and SC Mode with SC Gain uses an external sidechain.
native instruments|vc 76.name: VC 76

nicky romero|kickstart.about: Kickstart is a sidechain-style volume ducking effect from Nicky Romero that creates the pumping effect normally made with a sidechained compressor, without needing a kick input. It is good for EDM-style pumping on pads, bass and buses, or for making room for a kick drum. Used Wave selects the ducking curve shape, Loop Length and Speed Type set how often it repeats against tempo, and Mix sets the depth of the ducking. The Midi In controls allow triggering the duck from MIDI notes instead of the tempo grid.
nicky romero|kickstart.name: Kickstart

nicky romero|kickstart 2.about: Kickstart 2 is a sidechain-style volume ducking effect from Nicky Romero that creates tempo-synced pumping without needing a kick input. It is good for EDM-style pumping on pads, bass and buses, or ducking only the low end to make room for a kick. Used Wave selects the ducking curve shape, Loop Length sets its length against tempo, and Mix sets the depth. Band On with Band Frequency limits the ducking to part of the spectrum (for example only the lows).
nicky romero|kickstart 2.name: Kickstart 2

noise makers|ambi head.about: Ambi Head is a Noise Makers binaural decoder that renders a first-order ambisonic (four-channel) signal to stereo for headphone listening. It is good for monitoring or delivering 360 and VR audio on headphones. Yaw, Pitch and Roll rotate the listener's head orientation within the sound field, Width adjusts the stereo spread of the render, and Gain sets the output level.
noise makers|ambi head.name: Ambi Head

noise makers|ambi head hd.about: Ambi Head HD is a Noise Makers binaural decoder that renders an ambisonic signal to two-channel binaural stereo for headphone listening. It is good for monitoring or delivering 360, VR and game audio on headphones. Yaw, Pitch and Roll rotate the listener's head orientation within the sound field, Width adjusts the spread of the render, and Gain sets the output level.
noise makers|ambi head hd.name: Ambi Head HD

noise makers|ambi limiter.about: Ambi Limiter is a Noise Makers peak limiter for ambisonic (four-channel) signals that limits all channels together so the spatial image is preserved. It is good for keeping 360 and VR mixes below a ceiling without distorting source directions. Max Peak Level sets the ceiling, Input Gain drives the signal into the limiter, and Attack Time and Release Time set how quickly it reacts and recovers.
noise makers|ambi limiter.name: Ambi Limiter

noise makers|ambi limiter hd.about: Ambi Limiter HD is a Noise Makers peak limiter for ambisonic signals that limits all channels together so the spatial image is preserved. It is good for keeping 360 and VR mixes below a ceiling without distorting source directions. Max Peak Level sets the ceiling, Input Gain drives the signal into the limiter, and Attack Time and Release Time set how quickly it reacts and recovers.
noise makers|ambi limiter hd.name: Ambi Limiter HD

noise makers|ambi pan.about: Ambi Pan is a Noise Makers ambisonic panner that encodes a mono source into a four-channel first-order ambisonic sound field at a chosen direction. It is good for placing voices, effects and other mono sources in 360, VR or immersive mixes. Azimuth sets the horizontal direction, Elevation the height, Distance how far away the source sounds, and Width how spread out the source is. Gain sets the level; showOnAmbiScene only controls whether the source appears in the visual scene display.
noise makers|ambi pan.name: Ambi Pan

noise makers|ambi pan hd.about: Ambi Pan HD is a Noise Makers ambisonic panner that encodes a mono source into an ambisonic sound field at a chosen direction. It is good for placing voices, effects and other mono sources in 360, VR or immersive mixes. Azimuth sets the horizontal direction, Elevation the height, Distance how far away the source sounds, and Width how spread out the source is. Gain sets the level; showOnAmbiScene only controls whether the source appears in the visual scene display.
noise makers|ambi pan hd.name: Ambi Pan HD

noise makers|ambi verb hd.about: Ambi Verb HD is a Noise Makers reverb that works directly on multichannel ambisonic signals, adding a spatial reverb tail in the ambisonic domain. It is good for adding room and ambience to 360, VR and immersive mixes while keeping the result in ambisonic format. DryWet sets the reverb balance, PreDelay delays the onset of the tail, Spread controls how widely the reverb is distributed, and Gain sets the output level.
noise makers|ambi verb hd.name: Ambi Verb HD

plugin alliance|acme opticom xla-3.about: Acme Opticom XLA-3 is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the Acme Audio Opticom XLA-3 optical tube compressor, giving smooth, program-dependent leveling. It is good for vocals, bass, acoustic instruments and buses where gentle, musical compression is wanted. Input Gain drives the compressor (more input means more compression), Output Gain sets makeup level, Response chooses the speed of the optical release, and Mode selects compress or limit behavior. Dry/Wet Mix allows parallel compression and Stereo Link ties both channels together.
plugin alliance|acme opticom xla-3.name: Acme Opticom XLA-3

plugin alliance|ada flanger.about: ADA Flanger is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the classic ADA analog flanger pedal, producing jet-like flanging sweeps through to chorus and metallic tones. It is good for guitars, drums, synths and vocals that need movement or a dramatic swept effect. Manual sets the base delay (where the sweep sits), Range the sweep depth and Speed the sweep rate (Sync and Synced Speed lock it to tempo). Enhance adds resonance/intensity, Threshold controls the original unit's level-dependent behavior, Mix sets the wet/dry balance, and Stereo widens the result.
plugin alliance|ada flanger.name: ADA Flanger

plugin alliance|ada std-1 stereo tapped.about: ADA STD-1 Stereo Tapped Delay is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the ADA STD-1 hardware, a short multi-tap analog delay used for stereo doubling, chorus-like thickening and widening. It is good for spreading mono guitars, vocals and synths across the stereo field, and for short ambience or flanging-style effects. Fixed Delay and Delay Sweep set the base delay time and its range, Delay Modulation adds movement, Tap Assign 1-6 route the delay taps to the left or right side, and Regeneration Level with Regeneration Tap sets feedback. Delay Mix sets the effect level and Hi-Cut darkens it.
plugin alliance|ada std-1 stereo tapped.name: ADA STD-1 Stereo Tapped Delay

plugin alliance|adptr metricab.about: ADPTR MetricAB is a reference-track comparison tool that lets you switch between your mix and loaded reference tracks at matched loudness. It is good for checking a mix or master against commercial references while working. AB Switch toggles between your mix (A) and the reference (B), Loudness Match equalizes perceived level so the comparison is fair, and the Filter controls (Filter Switch, Filter Preset, Filter Low Freq, Filter High Freq) solo a frequency band on both. Stereo Mode lets you compare mono, left, right or side signals.
plugin alliance|adptr metricab.name: ADPTR MetricAB

plugin alliance|amek eq 200.about: AMEK EQ 200 is a Plugin Alliance emulation of an AMEK five-band parametric equalizer with high- and low-pass filters, offered in stereo, dual-channel or mid/side form. It is good for precise tonal shaping on mixes and mastering as well as individual tracks. Each band (LF, LMF, MF, HMF, HF) has Gain, Freq and Q controls, and HP Freq and LP Freq trim the extremes; the number suffix selects channel 1 or 2, and Param Link ties both channels together. THD adds analog-style harmonic coloration, Mid Side processes mid and side separately, and Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|amek eq 200.name: AMEK EQ 200

plugin alliance|amek eq 250.about: AMEK EQ 250 is a Plugin Alliance emulation of an AMEK console parametric equalizer with high- and low-pass filters, offered in stereo, dual-channel or mid/side form. It is good for musical tonal shaping on mix buses, mastering and individual tracks. Each band (LF, LMF, MF, HMF, HF) has Gain, Freq and Q controls, and HP Freq and LP Freq trim the extremes; the number suffix selects channel 1 or 2, and Param Link ties both channels together. THD adds analog-style harmonic coloration and Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|amek eq 250.name: AMEK EQ 250

plugin alliance|ampeg b15n.about: Ampeg B15N is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the vintage Ampeg B-15N Portaflex bass amp and cabinet. It is good for warm, round, vintage bass tones from a DI recording, from clean to lightly broken up. Pick a channel with InputCh and set its Volume, Bass and Treble (Ch64 or Ch66 controls); Input drives the amp and PowerSoak lowers output while keeping the power-amp drive. RecChain selects the cabinet and microphone recording chain, the NgByPass/NgThres/NgRange controls set a noise gate, and Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs.
plugin alliance|ampeg b15n.name: Ampeg B15N

plugin alliance|ampeg svt3pro.about: Ampeg SVT3Pro is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the Ampeg SVT-3 Pro bass head and cabinets. It is good for modern, punchy bass tones from a DI, from clean to gritty. Gain and TubeGain set the drive, Bass, Mid with MidFreq and Treble shape the tone, and Master sets amp volume; the EqB1-EqB9 graphic EQ (with EQPower) offers further shaping. RecChain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, the NgByPass/NgThres/NgRange controls set a noise gate, and Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs.
plugin alliance|ampeg svt3pro.name: Ampeg SVT3Pro

plugin alliance|ampeg svtvr.about: Ampeg SVTVR is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the Ampeg SVT-VR all-tube bass head with cabinets. It is good for classic rock bass tones from a DI, from big clean low end to tube growl. Choose a channel with InputCh, then shape it with that channel's Volume, Treble, Middle and Bass plus the UltraHi and UltraLow switches. Input drives the amp, PowerSoak lowers output while keeping the drive, RecChain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, and Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs; the NgByPass/NgThres/NgRange controls set a noise gate.
plugin alliance|ampeg svtvr.name: Ampeg SVTVR

plugin alliance|ampeg svtvr classic.about: Ampeg SVTVR Classic is a simplified Plugin Alliance emulation of the Ampeg SVT-VR tube bass head and cabinet. It is good for quick, classic rock bass tones from a DI. Ch2Volume sets drive, Ch2Bass and Ch2Treble shape the tone, and Ch2UltraLow and Ch2UltraHi add low or high emphasis. Input sets the level into the amp, PowerSoak lowers output while keeping the drive, and RecChain selects the cabinet and microphone chain.
plugin alliance|ampeg svtvr classic.name: Ampeg SVTVR Classic

plugin alliance|ampeg v4b.about: Ampeg V4B is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the Ampeg V-4B tube bass head with cabinets. It is good for vintage, gritty rock bass tones from a DI. Gain sets the preamp drive, Bass, Midle (with MidFreq) and Treble shape the tone, UltraLow and UltraHi add emphasis, and Master sets amp volume. RecChain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, PowerSoak lowers output while keeping the drive, Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs, and the NgByPass/NgThres/NgRange controls set a noise gate.
plugin alliance|ampeg v4b.name: Ampeg V4B

plugin alliance|bettermaker eq232d.about: Bettermaker EQ232D is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the Bettermaker EQ232D, a two-channel equalizer combining a high-pass filter, two parametric bands and a passive-style low/high boost-and-cut section. It is good for mix-bus and mastering EQ as well as tracks, giving clean parametric control alongside broad musical shelving. HPF IN and HPF FREQ remove low end, EQ1 and EQ2 (IN, GAIN, FREQ, Q) handle targeted cuts or boosts, and the PEQ section (LO BOOST, LO ATTEN, LO CPS, HI BOOST, HI ATTEN, HI BW) adds shelf-style lows and highs. The suffix 1 or 2 selects the channel, MS MATRIX enables mid/side processing and LVL OUT sets output.
plugin alliance|bettermaker eq232d.name: Bettermaker EQ232D

plugin alliance|black box analog design.about: Black Box Analog Design HG-2 is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the HG-2 tube saturation processor, adding harmonic drive and density. It is good for adding warmth, thickness and perceived loudness to mix buses, masters, drums, bass and vocals. Input Gain drives the circuit, Pentode and Triode set the amount of the two tube stages, Saturation (with Saturation In and Saturation Frequency) adds extra drive focused on a frequency range, and Density adds low-end weight. Air (with Air In) lifts the top end, Mix allows parallel blending and Output sets level.
plugin alliance|black box analog design.name: Black Box Analog Design HG-2

plugin alliance|black box analog design.about: Black Box Analog Design HG-2MS is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the HG-2MS tube saturation processor with independent processing for two channels or mid and side. It is good for adding warmth, density and width to mix buses and masters, for example saturating the mid and side differently. Per channel, Pentode and Triode set the tube drive, Saturation with Saturation Frequency adds focused drive, and Air lifts the top end; Link ties the channels together. Input Gain drives the unit, Density adds low-end weight, Mix allows parallel blending, Mid/Side switches the processing mode and Total Output sets level.
plugin alliance|black box analog design.name: Black Box Analog Design HG-2MS

plugin alliance|bx_2098 eq.about: bx_2098 EQ is a Plugin Alliance analog-modeled four-band console equalizer with high- and low-pass filters, usable in stereo, dual-channel or mid/side form. It is good for musical tonal shaping on vocals, instruments, buses and mixes. LF, LMF, HMF and HF bands each have Gain and Frequency (the mids add Q and a Notch option, the LF and HF bands add Peak plus Glow and Sheen voicings), and HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes. The number suffix selects channel 1 or 2, and Line Trim sets the channel level.
plugin alliance|bx_2098 eq.name: bx_2098 EQ

plugin alliance|bx_bassdude.about: bx_bassdude is a Plugin Alliance bass amplifier and cabinet simulator modeled on a classic tube bass head. It is good for turning a DI bass into an amp tone, from clean and round to growling. Channel selects the Bass or Normal channel, whose Vol, Bass and Treble controls (BassVol, BassBass, BassTreb or NormVol, NormBass, NormTreb) set drive and tone, and Presence adds upper bite. Rec_Chain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, Power_Soak lowers output while keeping the drive, Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs, and the NG controls set a noise gate.
plugin alliance|bx_bassdude.name: bx_bassdude

plugin alliance|bx_blackdist2.about: bx_blackdist2 is a Plugin Alliance distortion pedal emulation modeled on a classic black op-amp distortion box. It is good for gritty to fuzzy distortion on guitar, bass, synths and drums. Dist sets the amount of distortion, Filter sets the tone (brightness) of the result, and Vol sets the output level. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_blackdist2.name: bx_blackdist2

plugin alliance|bx_bluechorus2.about: bx_bluechorus2 is a Plugin Alliance analog chorus pedal emulation that thickens and widens a sound with a pitch-modulated copy. It is good for guitars, clean keys, pads and bass that need warmth and movement. Rate sets the modulation speed, Depth the amount of pitch wobble, and Mix the balance between dry and chorused signal. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_bluechorus2.name: bx_bluechorus2

plugin alliance|bx_boom.about: bx_boom is a Plugin Alliance kick-drum low-end processor that adds or reduces the boom of a kick with a single control. It is good for quickly making a kick drum fuller or tighter. Boom! Factor sets the amount (positive values add low-end boom, negative values reduce it) and Mode chooses between the LO and HI settings, which target different frequency areas.
plugin alliance|bx_boom.name: bx_boom

plugin alliance|bx_cleansweep pro.about: bx_cleansweep Pro is a Plugin Alliance high-pass and low-pass filter plug-in for removing unwanted lows and highs. It is good for cleaning rumble, mud, hiss or excess top end from tracks and for narrowing bandwidth as an effect. Highpass On/Off and Highpass Cutoff set the low cut, Lowpass On/Off and Lowpass Cutoff set the high cut, and the Type and Order controls choose each filter's response and steepness. Input Gain sets level and Phase Rev. inverts polarity. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_cleansweep pro.name: bx_cleansweep Pro

plugin alliance|bx_cleansweep v2.about: bx_cleansweep V2 is a Plugin Alliance high-pass and low-pass filter plug-in for removing unwanted lows and highs. It is good for cleaning rumble from vocals and instruments, removing hiss or excess top end, and making room in a mix. Highpass On/Off with Highpass Cutoff sets the low cut and Lowpass On/Off with Lowpass Cutoff sets the high cut. Input Gain sets level and Phase Rev. inverts polarity. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_cleansweep v2.name: bx_cleansweep V2

plugin alliance|bx_console amek 9099.about: bx_console AMEK 9099 is a Plugin Alliance channel-strip emulation of the AMEK 9099 console, combining filters, EQ, a compressor, a gate/expander and a limiter. It is good as a complete channel strip for vocals, drums, bass and instruments. HighPass Filter and LowPass Filter trim the extremes; the compressor uses Comp Threshold, Comp Ratio, Comp Attack, Comp Release and Comp Mix; the gate uses Gate Threshold, Gate Range, Gate Hold and Gate Release; and Limiter Level sets the limiter. THD and Virtual Gain add console coloration and noise, and Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_console amek 9099.name: bx_console AMEK 9099

plugin alliance|bx_console focusrite sc.about: bx_console Focusrite SC is a Plugin Alliance channel-strip emulation of the Focusrite Studio Console, combining filters, four-band EQ, a compressor, a de-esser and a gate/expander. It is good as a complete channel strip for vocals, drums, bass and instruments. HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes; the EQ uses EQ LF, EQ LMF, EQ HMF and EQ HF Freq/Gain/Q controls; the compressor uses Comp Threshold, Comp Ratio, Comp Attack, Comp Release and Comp Makeupgain; DeEsser Bandpass Freq and DeEsser Sensitivity control sibilance; and the Gate controls clean up noise. THD and Virtual Gain add console coloration, and In Gain and Out Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_console focusrite sc.name: bx_console Focusrite SC

plugin alliance|bx_console n.about: bx_console N is a Plugin Alliance channel-strip emulation of a large-format Neve console channel, combining filters, four-band EQ, a limiter/compressor and a gate/expander. It is good as a complete channel strip for vocals, drums, bass and instruments. HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes; the EQ uses EQ Low, Low Mid, High Mid and High bands with Frequency, Gain and Q; the compressor uses LC Threshold, LC Ratio, LC Attack and LC Release; and the gate uses GE Threshold, GE Range and GE Release. EQ Position places EQ before or after dynamics, THD adds coloration, and In Gain and Out Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_console n.name: bx_console N

plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 4000 e.about: bx_console SSL 4000 E is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the SSL 4000 E console channel strip, combining filters, a four-band EQ, a compressor/limiter and a gate/expander. It is good as a punchy, classic channel strip for drums, vocals, bass and guitars. HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes; EQ Low, Low Mid, High Mid and High bands are set with their Gain and Frequency (Q on the mids, Bell switches on the outer bands), and EQ Type chooses between the two classic EQ versions. LC Threshold, LC Ratio and LC Release control compression, GE Mode, GE Threshold and GE Range control gating, and THD, In Gain and Out Gain set coloration and level.
plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 4000 e.name: bx_console SSL 4000 E

plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 4000 g.about: bx_console SSL 4000 G is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the SSL 4000 G console channel strip, combining filters, a four-band EQ, a compressor/limiter and a gate/expander. It is good as a classic channel strip for drums, vocals, bass, guitars and buses. HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes; EQ Low, Low Mid, High Mid and High bands are set with their Gain and Frequency (Q on the mids, Bell switches on the outer bands), and EQ Type chooses the EQ version. LC Threshold, LC Ratio and LC Release control compression, GE Mode, GE Threshold and GE Range control gating, and THD, In Gain and Out Gain set coloration and level.
plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 4000 g.name: bx_console SSL 4000 G

plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 9000 j.about: bx_console SSL 9000 J is a Plugin Alliance emulation of the SSL 9000 J console channel strip, combining filters, a four-band EQ, a compressor and a gate/expander. It is good as a clean, precise channel strip for vocals, drums, bass and instruments. HPF Frequency and LPF Frequency trim the extremes; EQ Low, Low Mid, High Mid and High bands are set with their Gain and Frequency (Q on the mids), and EQ Type chooses the EQ voicing. Comp Threshold, Comp Ratio, Comp Attack and Comp Release control compression, the Gate controls handle noise, Dyn Position orders dynamics and EQ, and THD, In Gain and Out Gain set coloration and level.
plugin alliance|bx_console ssl 9000 j.name: bx_console SSL 9000 J

plugin alliance|bx_control v2.about: bx_control V2 is a Plugin Alliance stereo and mid/side utility for monitoring, channel routing, polarity and width. It is good for checking mono compatibility, soloing mid or side, fixing swapped or polarity-inverted channels, and adjusting stereo width or low-end mono. M Solo, S Solo, L Solo and R Solo isolate parts of the signal, L <-> R swaps channels, Phase Rev. L and Phase Rev. R invert polarity, Stereo-Width sets width, Mono-Maker makes the lows mono below its frequency, and Balance, Pan M and Pan S adjust placement. Input Gain trims level.
plugin alliance|bx_control v2.name: bx_control V2

plugin alliance|bx_crispytuner.about: bx_crispytuner is a Plugin Alliance pitch-correction plug-in that tunes notes to a key and scale, from natural correction to a hard robotic effect. It is good for correcting vocals and monophonic instruments or creating stylized tuned vocals. Scale Override and Root Key Override set the target scale and key, Reference Frequency the tuning reference, Amount and Tightness how strongly notes are pulled to pitch, and Transition Time how fast pitch moves between notes (shorter is more robotic). Pitch Tolerance and Time Tolerance leave intentional slides and vibrato alone, Transpose and Pitch Shift move pitch, and Formant Preservation and Formant Shift control vocal character.
plugin alliance|bx_crispytuner.name: bx_crispytuner

plugin alliance|bx_delay2500.about: bx_delay2500 is a Plugin Alliance stereo delay with modulation, feedback filtering, distortion, ducking and transient-dependent shaping. It is good for vocal echoes, rhythmic synced delays, slapback, ping-pong-style stereo repeats and gritty creative delays. Time L and Time R (or Note L and Note R with Host Synchronization) set delay times, Feedback L and Feedback R the repeats and Mix L and Mix R the level, with Link switches to tie both sides. Feedback Low Pass and Feedback Hi Pass darken or thin the repeats, the Modulation and Distortion sections add movement and grit, and Ducking Amount lowers echoes while the dry signal plays.
plugin alliance|bx_delay2500.name: bx_delay2500

plugin alliance|bx_digital v3.about: bx_digital V3 is a Plugin Alliance mastering-grade stereo and mid/side equalizer with five bands per channel, filters, a dynamic EQ band and stereo tools. It is good for mix-bus and mastering EQ, mid/side tonal balance, mono-making low end and de-essing with its dynamic band. Modus selects stereo, dual or mid/side processing; each band (EQ Band LF, LMF, MF, HMF, HF) has Type, Gain, Q and Frequency for channel 1 or 2, and the High-pass and Low-pass Frequency and Slope controls trim the extremes. Mono-Maker Frequency makes lows mono, Stereo Width sets width, Link Channels ties the channels together, and Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_digital v3.name: bx_digital V3

plugin alliance|bx_digital v3 mix.about: bx_digital V3 mix is a Plugin Alliance single-channel version of bx_digital V3: a five-band equalizer with filters, bass and presence shift bands, and a dynamic EQ band. It is good for precise tonal shaping on individual tracks and controlling sibilance or resonances dynamically. Each band (EQ Band LF, LMF, MF, HMF, HF) has Type, Gain, Q and Frequency, and High-pass and Low-pass Frequency and Slope trim the extremes. Bass Shift and Presence Shift offer quick broad tone moves, and the Dynamic EQ controls (Frequency, Range, Speed, Compression, Expansion) act only when the band gets loud; Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_digital v3 mix.name: bx_digital V3 mix

plugin alliance|bx_distorange.about: bx_distorange is a Plugin Alliance emulation of a classic orange compact distortion pedal. It is good for crunchy to heavy distortion on guitar, as well as gritty bass, synths and drums. Dist sets the amount of distortion, Tone the brightness and Level the output volume. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_distorange.name: bx_distorange

plugin alliance|bx_dyneq v2.about: bx_dynEQ V2 is a Plugin Alliance two-band dynamic equalizer whose bands cut or boost only when the signal at a key frequency crosses a threshold. It is good for taming harshness, sibilance or resonances only when they occur, controlling boomy notes, and mid/side dynamic EQ on mixes. For each band, EQ Frequency, EQ Type and EQ Factor set the band, EQ Threshold sets when it acts, EQ Boost/Cut and EQ Max. Gain set the direction and maximum amount, and EQ Attack and EQ Release the timing. EQ Key Fq and EQ Key Type set the detector band, EQ Sidechain selects an external key, and Mode selects stereo or mid/side processing.
plugin alliance|bx_dyneq v2.name: bx_dynEQ V2

plugin alliance|bx_dyneq v2 mono.about: bx_dynEQ V2 Mono is a single-band mono version of Plugin Alliance's dynamic equalizer: the band cuts or boosts only when the signal at a key frequency crosses a threshold. It is good for taming sibilance, harsh resonances or boomy notes on a single track only when they occur. EQ Frequency, EQ Type and EQ Factor set the band, EQ Threshold sets when it acts, EQ Boost/Cut and EQ Max. Gain set the direction and maximum amount, and EQ Attack and EQ Release the timing. EQ Key Fq and EQ Key Type set the detector band and EQ Sidechain selects an external key.
plugin alliance|bx_dyneq v2 mono.name: bx_dynEQ V2 Mono

plugin alliance|bx_greenscreamer.about: bx_greenscreamer is a Plugin Alliance emulation of a classic green overdrive pedal. It is good for mild to medium overdrive on guitar, for tightening and pushing an amp sim, or for adding warm grit to bass, synths and vocals. Overdrive sets the amount of drive, Tone the brightness and Level the output volume. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_greenscreamer.name: bx_greenscreamer

plugin alliance|bx_hybrid v2.about: bx_hybrid V2 is a Plugin Alliance stereo and mid/side equalizer with five parametric bands per channel, high- and low-pass filters, and stereo tools. It is good for mix-bus and mastering EQ as well as tracks, including separate mid and side shaping. Each band (Lf, Lmf, Mf, Hmf, Hf) has Frequency, Gain and Quality with an On/Off switch for channel 1 or 2, and HP and LP Frequency trim the extremes. Mono-Maker makes the low end mono, Stereo-Width sets width, and Link All On/Off ties the channels together.
plugin alliance|bx_hybrid v2.name: bx_hybrid V2

plugin alliance|bx_hybrid v2 mix.about: bx_hybrid V2 mix is a single-channel version of Plugin Alliance's bx_hybrid V2 equalizer, with five parametric bands, high- and low-pass filters, and bass and presence shift bands. It is good for tonal shaping and corrective EQ on individual tracks. Each band (1 Lf, 1 Lmf, 1 Mf, 1 Hmf, 1 Hf) has Frequency, Gain and Quality with an On/Off switch, and 1 HP Frequency and 1 LP Frequency trim the extremes. The 1 BS and 1 PS bands (bass and presence shift) give quick broad tone moves, and 1 Input Gain and 1 Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_hybrid v2 mix.name: bx_hybrid V2 mix

plugin alliance|bx_limiter.about: bx_limiter is a Plugin Alliance peak limiter for raising loudness and catching peaks on mixes, buses and tracks. It is good for final-stage loudness and for keeping buses or stems from clipping. Gain Boost pushes the signal into the limiter, Threshold sets where limiting starts, and Release sets recovery speed. XL Active with XL adds saturation-style peak handling, Channel Link sets how strongly both channels are limited together, and Mix allows parallel blending.
plugin alliance|bx_limiter.name: bx_limiter

plugin alliance|bx_limiter true peak.about: bx_limiter True Peak is a Plugin Alliance mastering limiter with true-peak (intersample) ceiling control and loudness metering. It is good for final masters that must stay below a true-peak ceiling while reaching a loudness target. Gain pushes the signal into the limiter, Ceiling sets the maximum output peak, and Release sets recovery speed; Limiter Mode chooses the limiting character. XL Saturation adds saturation-style peak handling, Channel Link links both channels, Limiter Mix allows parallel blending, and Foundation adds low-end weight.
plugin alliance|bx_limiter true peak.name: bx_limiter True Peak

plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk.about: bx_masterdesk is a Plugin Alliance all-in-one mastering processor combining a compressor, tone controls, de-esser, resonance filters, stereo tools and a limiter in a simple interface. It is good for quickly finishing a mix to a loud, balanced master. Volume sets the loudness driven into the limiter and Output Trim the final level; TMT Compressor Mode and Compressor Mix set glue compression. Foundation adds low-end weight, Bass, Mid, Treble and Presence shape tone, De-Esser tames sibilance, Low and High Resonance Filter cut resonances, Stereo Enhance adjusts width and Mono Maker makes the lows mono.
plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk.name: bx_masterdesk

plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk classic.about: bx_masterdesk Classic is a simplified Plugin Alliance mastering processor with compression, tone, saturation and limiting behind a few controls. It is good for quick, straightforward mastering of a mix. Volume sets the loudness driven into the limiter, Output Trim the final level, TMT Compressor Mode the compression character, Foundation the low-end weight, Tone Adjust (with Tone Mode) the overall tonal tilt, THD the harmonic coloration and Stereo Enhance the width.
plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk classic.name: bx_masterdesk Classic

plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk true peak.about: bx_masterdesk True Peak is a Plugin Alliance all-in-one mastering processor like bx_masterdesk, with a true-peak limiter for intersample-safe output. It is good for quickly finishing a mix to a loud master that meets streaming peak limits. Volume sets the loudness driven into the limiter, True Peak enables true-peak limiting and Output Trim sets the final level; TMT Compressor Mode and Compressor Mix set glue compression. Foundation adds low-end weight, Bass, Mid, Treble and Presence shape tone, De-Esser tames sibilance, the Resonance Filters cut resonances, and Stereo Enhance and Mono Maker shape the stereo image.
plugin alliance|bx_masterdesk true peak.name: bx_masterdesk True Peak

plugin alliance|bx_megadual.about: bx_megadual is a Plugin Alliance high-gain guitar amp and cabinet simulator modeled on a classic three-channel dual-rectifier tube head. It is good for modern rock and metal rhythm and lead tones, as well as cleans from the first channel. ChSwitch selects the channel, each with Mode, Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Pres and Master (Ch1, Ch2, Ch3 prefixes); Power Mode and Rectifier Mode change feel and tightness. Rec_Chain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs, the NG controls set a noise gate, and the Delay controls add a simple echo.
plugin alliance|bx_megadual.name: bx_megadual

plugin alliance|bx_megasingle.about: bx_megasingle is a Plugin Alliance guitar amp and cabinet simulator modeled on a classic two-channel single-rectifier tube head. It is good for clean, crunch and high-gain guitar tones. ChSwitch selects the Clean or Lead channel, each with Mode, Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Pres and Master (Cl and Le prefixes). Rec_Chain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, Power_Soak lowers output while keeping the drive, Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs, the NG controls set a noise gate, and the Delay controls add a simple echo.
plugin alliance|bx_megasingle.name: bx_megasingle

plugin alliance|bx_metal2.about: bx_metal2 is a Plugin Alliance emulation of a classic high-gain metal distortion pedal with an active EQ. It is good for heavy, saturated guitar distortion and aggressive bass or synth tones. Dist sets the amount of distortion, Low and High shape bass and treble, Mid with MidFreq boosts or cuts a sweepable midrange, and Level sets the output volume. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_metal2.name: bx_metal2

plugin alliance|bx_meter.about: bx_meter is a Plugin Alliance stereo level, loudness and correlation meter that passes audio unchanged. It is good for checking levels, stereo balance and phase correlation while mixing and mastering. Mode chooses stereo or mid/side display, Metering selects the metering scale, and L Solo, R Solo, M Solo and S Solo let you listen to individual parts of the signal; Stereo Swap swaps left and right.
plugin alliance|bx_meter.name: bx_meter

plugin alliance|bx_opto.about: bx_opto is a Plugin Alliance optical-style compressor that gives smooth, program-dependent compression with few controls. It is good for vocals, bass, acoustic instruments and buses that need gentle leveling. Peak Reduction sets the amount of compression, Speed the response, and Output Gain the makeup level. The sidechain filter (Sidechain Filter Type, Sidechain Frequency, Sidechain Off/On/Solo) stops chosen frequencies such as low end from driving the compression, and Mix allows parallel blending.
plugin alliance|bx_opto.name: bx_opto

plugin alliance|bx_opto pedal.about: bx_opto Pedal is a Plugin Alliance optical compressor in a simple pedal format. It is good for quick, smooth compression on guitar, bass, vocals and other tracks. Density sets the amount of compression, Speed the response time and Level Trim the output level.
plugin alliance|bx_opto pedal.name: bx_opto Pedal

plugin alliance|bx_paneq.about: bx_PanEQ is a stereo pan EQ that equalizes selected frequency bands and steers them left or right. It is good for balancing left and right frequency content, centering bass, spreading mids or highs, and fixing stereo imbalance. Start with Bank A and Output Gain 0 dB. Set Band1 Active On, choose Band1 Frequency for the range (for example 80 Hz lows, 1 kHz mids, 8 kHz highs), set Band1 Q to about 1 to 2, Band1 Gain to +3 dB or -3 dB, and Band1 Pan at C or toward 100 L/R. Use Band2 Active and Band3 Active for additional bands, and keep unused bands Off. Band1 Solo helps isolate the band during setup.
plugin alliance|bx_paneq.name: bx_panEQ

plugin alliance|bx_refinement.about: bx_refinement is a Plugin Alliance processor that dynamically reduces harshness and harsh high-mid resonances, with optional saturation and presence shaping. It is good for taming harsh vocals, cymbals, guitars or bright mixes without dulling them. Damping sets how much harshness is removed and Character its tonal behavior, Dynamics with Dynamics Range and Dynamics Speed makes the reduction react to level, and Solo Filter lets you hear what is being removed. Saturation and Presence add warmth or lift back, Channels selects stereo or mid/side processing, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
plugin alliance|bx_refinement.name: bx_refinement

plugin alliance|bx_rockergain100.about: bx_rockergain100 is a Plugin Alliance guitar amp and cabinet simulator modeled on a classic British two-channel tube amp. It is good for clean tones and classic to modern rock crunch and leads. Channel selects Clean or Dirty; Clean Volume, Clean Bass and Clean Treble shape the clean channel, and Dirty Gain, Dirty Bass, Dirty Middle, Dirty Treble and Dirty Volume the drive channel, with Master Volume overall. Recording Chain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, Power Soak lowers output while keeping the drive, Tight and Smooth filter the lows and highs, and the NoiseGate and Delay controls add a gate and a simple echo.
plugin alliance|bx_rockergain100.name: bx_rockergain100

plugin alliance|bx_rockrack v3.about: bx_rockrack V3 is a Plugin Alliance guitar amp rack with several amp models, cabinets and recording chains, a noise gate and extras. It is good for a wide range of guitar tones, from jazz cleans to crunch, modern rock and metal. Amplifier Type selects the amp model, whose Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Presence and Volume controls (prefixed by the model name, e.g. ModernRock Gain) shape the tone. Recording Chain selects the cabinet and microphone chain, Noise Gate with Noise Gate Threshold cleans up noise, Shred adds a pre-amp boost and Master Out sets the final level.
plugin alliance|bx_rockrack v3.name: bx_rockrack V3

plugin alliance|bx_rockrack v3 player.about: bx_rockrack V3 Player is a preset-only version of Plugin Alliance's bx_rockrack V3 guitar amp rack. It is good for quickly getting a ready-made guitar amp tone. Preset selects the stored amp setup and Master Out sets the output level; the amp controls themselves are not exposed.
plugin alliance|bx_rockrack v3 player.name: bx_rockrack V3 Player

plugin alliance|bx_rooms.about: bx_rooMS is a Plugin Alliance algorithmic reverb focused on realistic rooms, with mid/side processing and built-in EQ. It is good for placing vocals, drums and instruments in natural-sounding spaces or adding larger ambience. Room Size, Room Shape and Reverb Time define the space, Predelay delays the onset of the tail, and Mix (or Dry Signal) sets the balance. Source Distance and Directivity change how close the source sounds, the HiShelf, LoShelf, Low Pass, High Pass and Eq1/Eq2 controls shape the reverb tone, Stereo Width sets width and Modulation Amount adds movement.
plugin alliance|bx_rooms.name: bx_rooMS

plugin alliance|bx_saturator v2.about: bx_saturator V2 is a Plugin Alliance multiband mid/side saturation processor that drives low and high bands of the mid and side signals separately. It is good for adding warmth, density and presence to mix buses and masters, for example saturating the low mid without touching the sides. Master Drive sets overall drive and Mid Lo Drive, Mid Hi Drive, Side Lo Drive and Side Hi Drive the drive per band, with Mid XL Crossover and Side XL Crossover setting the split frequencies. The XL controls add peak-limiting saturation, Output Gain M and Output Gain S set levels, and Mono-Maker makes the lows mono.
plugin alliance|bx_saturator v2.name: bx_saturator V2

plugin alliance|bx_shredspread.about: bx_shredspread is a Plugin Alliance tool for widening and filling out guitar tracks, mostly aimed at heavy rhythm guitars. It is good for making a guitar sound wider and more powerful in the stereo field, and for keeping its low end centered. Stereo Width sets the widening, MonoMaker Cutoff keeps the lows mono below its frequency, Shred Filter cuts harsh or fizzy content, and Gain sets level. Threshold (or Auto Mode) controls the built-in level-dependent processing, and Solo Pan and Mid Solo are for checking the result.
plugin alliance|bx_shredspread.name: bx_shredspread

plugin alliance|bx_solo.about: Plugin Alliance bx_solo is a stereo analyzer/solo plug-in that routes the incoming stereo pair so you can listen to selected parts by soloing left, right, mid, or side, swapping the channels, and changing stereo width. It is useful for checking mono compatibility, separating the center from the sides, spotting phase or channel problems, and making quick balance decisions. For common jobs, leave all toggles Off for normal listening; turn Solo L or Solo R On to inspect one channel; turn Solo M On to hear the center material or Solo S On to hear only the sides; set L <-> R On when left and right need to be reversed; use Stereo Width at 100 for unaltered width, below 100 for a tighter image, and above 100 for extra width; set Bypass On to return the signal unchanged.
plugin alliance|bx_solo.name: bx_solo

plugin alliance|bx_stereomaker.about: bx_stereomaker is a Plugin Alliance stereo widener that creates a stereo image from mono or narrow sources while staying mono compatible. It is good for widening mono synths, guitars, vocals and pads, or adding width to stereo material. Stereo Expansion sets the amount of width, Tone shifts where the width is focused, Damp reduces width in the highs, and Mono Frequency keeps lows mono below its setting. Pan with Pan Mode positions the result, Solo Mid and Solo Side are for checking, and Output Gain sets level.
plugin alliance|bx_stereomaker.name: bx_stereomaker

plugin alliance|bx_subfilter.about: bx_subfilter is a Plugin Alliance resonant low-end filter for tightening and shaping the bass region of kicks, bass and mixes. It is good for adding a focused low-end bump or cleaning up a boomy bottom end. Low End boosts or cuts the low frequencies, Resonance sets how strong the resonant peak is, and Tight Punch Filter tightens the low end; Input Gain and Output Gain set levels. The A-D Setting/Bank slots store alternative settings for comparison, not different processing modes.
plugin alliance|bx_subfilter.name: bx_subfilter

plugin alliance|bx_subsynth.about: bx_subsynth is a Plugin Alliance subharmonic synthesizer that generates new low-octave content from the input, in three bands below about 80 Hz. It is good for adding sub weight to kicks, bass and electronic music, or extending thin low end. The 24 - 36Hz, 36 - 56Hz and 56 - 80Hz controls set how much synthesized sub is added in each band, Subharmonics and Mix set overall amount and wet/dry balance, and Drive and Squeeze add saturation and compression to the generated signal. Low End, Low Cut and High Cut shape the result, Mono Maker keeps the lows mono, and Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|bx_subsynth.name: bx_subsynth

plugin alliance|bx_townhouse buss compre.about: bx_townhouse Buss Compressor is a Plugin Alliance emulation of a classic console bus compressor used at a famous London studio, giving punchy, glueing compression. It is good for drum buses, mix buses and groups that need cohesion or pumping energy. Thresh and Ratio set the amount of compression, Attack and Release the timing, and MakeUp restores level. SC Filter keeps low end from driving the compressor, Mix allows parallel compression, Key In uses an external sidechain, and Virtual Gain adds console-style coloration.
plugin alliance|bx_townhouse buss compre.name: bx_townhouse Buss Compressor

plugin alliance|bx_tuner.about: Brainworx bx_tuner is a chromatic tuner that shows the pitch of the incoming audio; it does not change the sound. Use it to check instrument tuning. Reference Frequency sets the A reference (440 Hz standard), Tuner Mode chooses whether the signal passes or is muted while tuning, and Ballistics sets how fast the display reacts.
plugin alliance|bx_tuner.name: bx_tuner

plugin alliance|bx_xl v2.about: Brainworx bx_XL V2 is a mastering limiter with separate Mid Lo, Mid Hi and Side limiting stages plus a master stage, each with an XL control that adds harmonic saturation for extra perceived loudness. It is for raising the loudness of a mix or master while controlling peaks and keeping the low end and stereo image in check. The main controls per stage are Gain Boost (how hard it is driven), Max Out (ceiling) and XL (saturation amount); Crossover Frequeny sets the split between the Mid Lo and Mid Hi bands, Mono Maker narrows the bass, and Output Gain sets the final level.
plugin alliance|bx_xl v2.name: bx_XL V2

plugin alliance|bx_yellowdrive.about: Brainworx bx_yellowdrive is an overdrive pedal emulation that adds drive and saturation, mainly for guitar. Drive sets the amount of distortion, Tone sets brightness, and Level sets output volume. Setting switches between stored setting slots rather than changing the sound character itself.
plugin alliance|bx_yellowdrive.name: bx_yellowdrive

plugin alliance|chandler gav19t.about: Chandler GAV19T is a guitar amp simulation of the Chandler Limited GAV19T head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for clean to crunchy and overdriven electric guitar tones. Boost, Tone, Bass, Treble, Bias and Shape set the core amp voice, Input and InputTrim set drive into the amp, and Power_Soak and Rec_Chain shape power-amp feel and cabinet sound. NG_Thres and NG_Range gate noise, and Tight and Smooth (with their frequencies) trim lows and highs; Delay adds a simple echo.
plugin alliance|chandler gav19t.name: Chandler GAV19T

plugin alliance|dangerous bax eq master.about: Dangerous BAX EQ Master is a dual-channel Baxandall-style shelving EQ with low and high cut filters, used for broad, gentle tonal shaping on mixes and masters. Each channel has Low Shelf Frequency and Low Shelf Level, High Shelf Frequency and High Shelf Level, plus Low Cut Frequency and High Cut Frequency to remove rumble or extreme highs. Link ties the two channels together, and Mid/Side switches the two channels to mid and side processing; Output Level trims each channel.
plugin alliance|dangerous bax eq master.name: Dangerous BAX EQ Master

plugin alliance|dangerous bax eq mix.about: Dangerous BAX EQ Mix is a single-section Baxandall-style shelving EQ with low and high cut filters, for broad, smooth tonal shaping of tracks, buses or a mix. Low Shelf Level and Low Shelf Frequency add or remove weight, High Shelf Level and High Shelf Frequency add or remove brightness and air, and Low Cut Frequency and High Cut Frequency remove rumble or extreme top end. Output Level trims the result.
plugin alliance|dangerous bax eq mix.name: Dangerous BAX EQ Mix

plugin alliance|dearvr monitor.about: dearVR MONITOR is a headphone monitoring plug-in that simulates listening to speakers in a virtual room, so mixes can be checked on headphones as if on loudspeakers. Put it on the master output for monitoring only and bypass it before exporting. Speaker Layouts chooses the virtual speaker setup, Scenes chooses the room, Ambience sets how much room sound is heard, and Focus and Head Rotation adjust the image and listening direction; the HPC parameters apply headphone correction for a selected HPC Model.
plugin alliance|dearvr monitor.name: dearVR MONITOR

plugin alliance|dearvr music.about: dearVR music is a 3D spatializer that places a source in a virtual space with direction, distance and simulated room acoustics, rendering binaural output for headphones or other formats. Position the source with Azimuth, Elevation and Distance (or X, Y, Z when Coordinate System is set to Cartesian). Virtual Acoustics picks the room, Room Size, Reverb Gain and Reflection Gain set how much room is heard, and Direct Gain and Master Gain balance the dry source and overall level.
plugin alliance|dearvr music.name: dearVR music

plugin alliance|dearvr pro.about: dearVR PRO is a 3D spatializer that places a source in a virtual room with direction, distance, early reflections and reverb, for binaural, surround or ambisonic output. Position the source with Azimuth, Elevation and Distance (or X, Y, Z in Cartesian mode). Virtual Acoustics selects the room model, Room Size, Reverb Gain and Reflection Gain set the room amount, Occlusion simulates an obstacle between source and listener, and Direct Gain and Master Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|dearvr pro.name: dearVR pro

plugin alliance|diezel herbert.about: Diezel Herbert is a guitar amp simulation of the Diezel Herbert three-channel high-gain head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling. Channels selects Ch1 (clean), Ch2 or Ch3 (higher gain); each channel has its own Gain, Bass, Middle, Treble and Volume, and Presence and Deep shape the power-amp response. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|diezel herbert.name: Diezel Herbert

plugin alliance|diezel vh4.about: Diezel VH4 is a guitar amp simulation of the Diezel VH4 four-channel high-gain head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for clean to heavy metal guitar tones. Channels selects Ch1 to Ch4 (clean to most gain), each with its own Gain, Bass, Middle, Treble and Volume; Presence and Deep shape the power-amp response and Volume sets the master level. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|diezel vh4.name: Diezel VH4

plugin alliance|ds tantra 2.about: Dmitry Sches Tantra 2 is a rhythmic multi-effect that runs audio through two layers of effects (filter, distortion, delay, flanger, lo-fi, glitch and others) driven by synced modulators such as tremolo and gate patterns, followed by an EQ and reverb. It is for sound design: rhythmic gating, pulsing filters and glitchy movement on synths, pads, drums and loops. With hundreds of parameters it is best started from a preset; the overall Mix, Pan, Reverb Mix and the per-layer Mix controls are the safest to adjust by hand.
plugin alliance|ds tantra 2.name: DS Tantra 2

plugin alliance|elysia alpha master.about: elysia alpha master is a stereo mastering compressor with two channels (or mid and side when MS Mode is on), each with compression, a passive EQ section, soft clipping and a Warm mode. It is for glue and controlled density on masters and mix buses. The key per-channel controls are Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release for compression, Mix for parallel blend, Gain for make-up, EQ Gain and EQ Freq for tone, SC Freq with SC On to filter the detector, and Soft Clip with Soft Clip On to catch peaks; Link ties the two channels together.
plugin alliance|elysia alpha master.name: elysia alpha master

plugin alliance|elysia alpha mix.about: elysia alpha mix is a stereo compressor derived from elysia's alpha mastering compressor, for smooth, musical compression on buses and mixes. Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release set the compression, Mix blends in the dry signal for parallel compression, and Gain sets make-up level. SC On with SC Freq filters the low end out of the detector so bass does not drive the compression, and Warm adds a softer, rounder character.
plugin alliance|elysia alpha mix.name: elysia alpha mix

plugin alliance|elysia karacter master.about: elysia karacter master is a stereo saturation and distortion processor with two channels (or mid and side in MS Mode), for adding harmonics from subtle warmth to heavy grit on mixes, buses and masters. Drive sets the amount of saturation per channel, Color shifts the harmonic character, Gain sets output level and Mix blends with the dry signal. FET Shred switches to a more aggressive distortion and Turbo Boost adds more drive; Stereo Link ties the two channels together.
plugin alliance|elysia karacter master.name: elysia karacter master

plugin alliance|elysia karacter mix.about: elysia karacter mix is a saturation and distortion processor for adding harmonics, from gentle warmth to heavy grit, on single tracks and buses. Drive sets the amount of saturation, Color shifts the harmonic character, Gain sets output level and Mix blends with the dry signal for parallel saturation. FET Shred switches to a more aggressive distortion and Turbo Boost adds more drive.
plugin alliance|elysia karacter mix.name: elysia karacter mix

plugin alliance|elysia mpressor.about: elysia mpressor is a creative compressor that ranges from gentle leveling to heavy pumping and squashing, often used on drums and room sounds. Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release set the compression, Auto Fast speeds up the response on transients, and Gain sets make-up level. GR Limit (with GR Limit On) caps how much gain reduction can happen, and the EQ Gain and EQ Freq controls (with EQ On) shape the detector or tone; SC Extern uses an external sidechain.
plugin alliance|elysia mpressor.name: elysia mpressor

plugin alliance|elysia museq master.about: elysia museq master is a five-band stereo EQ with two channels (or mid and side in MS Mode), for musical tone shaping on mixes and masters. Each channel has Low and High shelf bands and Bottom, Middle and Top peak bands, each with its own Gain, Frequency and Mode (boost or cut), plus Q on the peak bands and Type on the shelves. Link ties the two channels together, Warm adds a softer analog character, and Output Level trims each channel.
plugin alliance|elysia museq master.name: elysia museq master

plugin alliance|elysia museq mix.about: elysia museq mix is a five-band EQ for musical tone shaping on tracks and buses. It has Low and High shelf bands and Bottom, Middle and Top peak bands, each with its own Gain, Frequency and Mode (boost or cut); the peak bands also have Q and the shelves have Type. Warm adds a softer analog character and Output Level trims the result.
plugin alliance|elysia museq mix.name: elysia museq mix

plugin alliance|elysia niveau filter.about: elysia niveau filter is a tilt EQ: one control raises the highs while lowering the lows (or the reverse) around a chosen center frequency. It is for quick, broad tonal balance, making a track or mix brighter or warmer without dialing in separate bands. EQ Gain sets the tilt direction and amount, EQ Freq sets the center frequency, and EQ Freq x10 multiplies the frequency range by ten.
plugin alliance|elysia niveau filter.name: elysia niveau filter

plugin alliance|elysia nvelope.about: elysia nvelope is a transient shaper that boosts or reduces the attack and sustain of a signal independently of its level, with an optional EQ mode. It is for adding or removing punch on drums, softening picking attack, or reducing room sound by shortening sustain. Mode Select chooses full-range, dual-band (attack and sustain each act on their own frequency range) or EQ operation; the shared controls Attack/Gain H and Sustain/Gain L set the amounts, the frequency controls set the bands, and Trim and Auto Gain manage output level.
plugin alliance|elysia nvelope.name: elysia nvelope
