plugin alliance|engl e646 vs.about: ENGL E646 VS is a guitar amp simulation of the ENGL E646 Victor Smolski signature head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for high-gain rock and metal guitar. The channel switches (ChSwUD, ChSwLR) select between the clean and lead channels; the lead channels use Gain3, Gain4, BassLd34, MidLd34, TrebLd34 and the clean channels GainCl/GainCr with their own EQ, while Presence, DepthPunch and MasterA/MasterB shape the output. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|engl e646 vs.name: ENGL E646 VS

plugin alliance|engl e765 rt.about: ENGL E765 RT is a guitar amp simulation of the ENGL Retro Tube 50 (E765) two-channel head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for crunch and lead rock tones. ChSwitch selects the channel; GainCh1, BassCh1, MidCh1, TrebleCh1, VolumeCh1 and the Ch2 equivalents set each channel's voice, GainBoost adds more drive and Master sets the amp level. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|engl e765 rt.name: ENGL E765 RT

plugin alliance|engl savage 120.about: ENGL Savage 120 is a guitar amp simulation of the ENGL Savage 120 head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, from clean and crunch to heavy lead tones. Channels Selection switches between the two main channels; Mch1 covers clean and crunch (Mch1 Gain, Mch1 Bass, Mch1 Middle, Mch1 Treble and the volumes) and Mch2 covers lead (Mch2 Gain, Mch2 Lead Gain, Mch2 Lead Boost and its EQ). Presence, Depth Boost and Master A/Master B shape the power-amp output. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|engl savage 120.name: ENGL Savage 120

plugin alliance|fiedler audio stage.about: Fiedler Audio Stage is a stereo placement tool that positions a source in the stereo field and in depth using short delays, phase and EQ rather than a full reverb. It is useful for giving tracks a defined place and width in a mix. pan and width set position and spread, size and feedback set the short delay-based space, and wet_gain balances it against the dry signal; bass, body, presence and brilliance (with Colour_on_off) shape the tone, and the LFO controls add movement.
plugin alliance|fiedler audio stage.name: fiedler audio stage

plugin alliance|friedman be100.about: Friedman BE100 is a guitar amp simulation of the Friedman BE-100 head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for classic British-style crunch to high-gain rock tones. Channels Switch selects the clean or BE (drive) channel; Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Presence and Master shape the drive channel, the Clean controls the clean channel, and Fat, C45 and SAT are voicing switches. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|friedman be100.name: Friedman BE100

plugin alliance|friedman buxom betty.about: Friedman Buxom Betty is a guitar amp simulation of the Friedman Buxom Betty single-channel head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for clean to edge-of-breakup and crunch tones. Volume sets the drive of the amp, Bass, Middle, Treble and Presence shape the tone, Bright adds top end, and Input Type chooses the input sensitivity. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|friedman buxom betty.name: Friedman Buxom Betty

plugin alliance|friedman ds40.about: Friedman DS40 is a guitar amp simulation of the Friedman Dirty Shirley 40 head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for crunchy, classic rock overdrive. Gain sets the amount of drive, Bass, Mid, Treble and Presence shape the tone, Master sets the amp level, and InputType chooses the input sensitivity. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|friedman ds40.name: Friedman DS40

plugin alliance|fuchs overdrive supreme.about: Fuchs Overdrive Supreme 50 is a guitar amp simulation of the Fuchs ODS 50 head, a smooth Dumble-style amp, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for clean to singing overdrive tones. Gain, Low, Mid, High and the voicing switches (Brite, Deep, Mid Boost) shape the preamp, Overdrive Mode engages the overdrive channel with its Input and Output, and Master sets the amp level. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|fuchs overdrive supreme.name: Fuchs Overdrive Supreme 50

plugin alliance|fuchs train ii.about: Fuchs Train II is a guitar amp simulation of the Fuchs Train II head, a low-power amp for clean to classic rock overdrive tones, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling. Gain1 and Gain2 set the drive, High, Mid and Low shape the tone, Accent and Thrust adjust upper and low-end response, and Master sets the level. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|fuchs train ii.name: Fuchs Train II

plugin alliance|gallien krueger 800rb.about: Gallien Krueger 800RB is a bass amp simulation of the GK 800RB bi-amp head, with separate low and high cabinet/microphone chains, for punchy, clear electric bass tones. Volume sets the preamp drive, Bass, Low Middle, Hi Middle and Treble shape the tone, and Low Cut, Mid Contour and Hi Boost are voicing switches. With Biamp Power on, Crossover splits the signal between the low and high chains (Low Master, Hi Master, Recording Chain Low, Recording Chain Hi); Boost adds extra drive and Master sets the output.
plugin alliance|gallien krueger 800rb.name: Gallien Krueger 800RB

plugin alliance|knif audio soma.about: Knif Audio Soma is a four-band tube EQ emulation with stepped frequencies, plus high- and low-pass filters, for musical tone shaping on mixes, masters and tracks. Each band has an on switch, Boost (gain), Frequency and Bandwidth; High Pass and Low Pass trim the extremes. The plug-in has two channels (or mid and side) that can be linked, with Mono Maker, Stereo Width and Input Gain/Output Gain in the outer section.
plugin alliance|knif audio soma.name: Knif Audio Soma

plugin alliance|lindell 254e.about: Lindell 254E is a compressor/limiter modeled on the classic Neve 2254 style, for thick, smooth compression on vocals, bass, drums and buses. Threshold, Ratio and Compress Recovery set the compression, Gain sets make-up level, and Limit with Limit Level and Limit Recovery adds a separate peak limiter. HPF filters low end from the detector, Mix blends the dry signal for parallel compression, and Ext SideChain uses an external key input.
plugin alliance|lindell 254e.name: Lindell 254E

plugin alliance|lindell 354e.about: Lindell 354E is a three-band multiband compressor in the style of vintage British console dynamics, for controlling low, mid and high ranges separately on buses and masters. Low XOverParameter and High XOverParameter set the band splits; each band has its own Threshold, Ratio, Attack, Recovery and Gain, with In and Solo switches. Mix blends in the dry signal and Master Gain sets the final level.
plugin alliance|lindell 354e.name: Lindell 354E

plugin alliance|lindell 50 buss.about: Lindell 50 Buss is a console bus emulation that adds the subtle saturation and color of an analog mix bus, without EQ or compression. Put it on a bus or the mix to add mild analog character. Input Level and Pre Gain set how hard the bus is driven, THD sets the amount of harmonic distortion, Cut is a low-cut switch, and Level and Output Level set the output; TMT Channel selects channel-to-channel component variation.
plugin alliance|lindell 50 buss.name: Lindell 50 Buss

plugin alliance|lindell 50 channel.about: Lindell 50 Channel is a console channel strip with preamp drive, EQ (a 10-band graphic and a parametric section), compression (VCA or FET) and a gate/expander. It is for shaping individual tracks with analog character in one plug-in. The parametric EQ uses Low, Low Mid, High Mid and High Freq/Gain controls plus High Pass Freq, the graphic EQ uses the Gain 31Hz to Gain 16kHz bands, the compressor uses VCA Threshold, VCA Ratio, VCA Attack, VCA Release, VCA Gain or the FET controls, and the gate uses Gate Threshold, Gate Range and Gate Release; THD and Pre Gain add saturation.
plugin alliance|lindell 50 channel.name: Lindell 50 Channel

plugin alliance|lindell 6x-500.about: Lindell 6X-500 is a tube preamp and simple EQ in a 500-series style, with low and high boosts plus high- and low-pass filters. Use it to add tube warmth and broad low or high lift to tracks. Input gain drives the tube stage, Low boost/Low frequency and Hi boost/Hi frequency set the shelving boosts, the Highpass and Lowpass frequency/slope controls trim the extremes, and Output level sets the final level; Analog toggles the modeled analog noise and behavior.
plugin alliance|lindell 6x-500.name: Lindell 6X-500

plugin alliance|lindell 7x-500.about: Lindell 7X-500 is an 1176-style FET compressor/limiter for fast, punchy compression on vocals, drums, bass and guitars. Input drives the compressor (more input means more compression), Output sets make-up level, Ratio selects the compression ratio, and Attack and Release set timing. Mix blends the dry signal for parallel compression, and SC High Pass Filter keeps low end from driving the detector.
plugin alliance|lindell 7x-500.name: Lindell 7X-500

plugin alliance|lindell 80 bus.about: Lindell 80 Bus is a console mix bus emulation in the style of a vintage 80-series British console, adding the saturation and color of the analog bus without EQ or compression. Put it on a bus or the mix for mild analog character. Input Level and Trim set the drive, THD sets the amount of harmonic distortion, Level and Output Level set the output, and TMT Channel selects channel-to-channel component variation.
plugin alliance|lindell 80 bus.name: Lindell 80 Bus

plugin alliance|lindell 80 channel.about: Lindell 80 Channel is a console channel strip in the style of a vintage 80-series British console, combining preamp drive, a three-band EQ with filters, a compressor/limiter and a gate/expander. It is for shaping individual tracks with classic console character. Low Gain/Low Frequency, Mid Gain/Mid Frequency and High Gain/High Frequency set the EQ, High Pass and Low Pass filter the extremes, Comp Threshold, Comp Ratio, Comp Recovery and Comp Gain set the compressor, and Gate Threshold, Gate Range and Gate Recovery set the gate; THD and Gain add saturation.
plugin alliance|lindell 80 channel.name: Lindell 80 Channel

plugin alliance|lindell 902 de-esser.about: Lindell 902 De-esser is a de-esser modeled on a classic console de-esser module, for reducing harsh sibilance on vocals and speech. Frequency sets where sibilance is detected, Range sets how much it is reduced, and Mode HF Only switches between reducing only the high frequencies or the whole signal. Listen lets you hear the detected band while tuning, Air adds a little top end back, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
plugin alliance|lindell 902 de-esser.name: Lindell 902 De-esser

plugin alliance|lindell channelx.about: Lindell ChannelX is a channel strip that chains a tube preamp with filters (the Pre. section), an FET compressor (the Comp. section) and a Pultec-style passive EQ (the EQ section). Use it to process a track with preamp warmth, punchy compression and broad tone shaping in one plug-in. The Pre. controls work like the Lindell 6X-500, the Comp. controls like the Lindell 7X-500 (Comp. Input, Comp. Ratio, Comp. Attack, Comp. Release, Comp. Output, Comp. Mix), and the EQ controls like the Lindell PEX-500 (EQ Low boost, EQ Low attenuation, EQ Hi boost, EQ Hi attenuation and their frequencies).
plugin alliance|lindell channelx.name: Lindell ChannelX

plugin alliance|lindell pex-500.about: Lindell PEX-500 is a Pultec-style passive EQ for broad, musical low and high shelving and boosting. Low frequency with Low boost and Low attenuation shapes the low end (boost and cut can be used together for a tight, full bottom), Hi frequency with Hi boost and Hi bandwidth adds presence or air, and Hi atten. freq. with Hi attenuation softens the top. Mid / Side switches to separate mid and side processing, and Analog toggles the modeled analog behavior.
plugin alliance|lindell pex-500.name: Lindell PEX-500

plugin alliance|lindell sbc.about: Lindell SBC is a VCA bus compressor in the style of the classic SSL bus compressor, for glue and punch on drum buses, mix buses and masters. Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release set the compression, Gain sets make-up level, and Mix blends the dry signal for parallel compression. SC HPF keeps low end from driving the detector, Knee softens the onset, Nuke and Filter add more extreme coloured compression modes, and External Side Chain uses a key input.
plugin alliance|lindell sbc.name: Lindell SBC

plugin alliance|lindell te-100.about: Lindell TE-100 is a passive-style program EQ with low and high shelving boost and cut sections plus two broad mid bands, for gentle tone shaping on tracks and mixes. Low Boost Freq/Low Boost Gain and Low Cut Freq/Low Atten. Gain shape the low end, High Boost Freq/High Boost Gain and High Cut Freq/High Atten. Gain shape the top, and the Low Band and High Band controls (with Mode set to boost or attenuate) adjust the mids. In Level and Out Level set gain staging.
plugin alliance|lindell te-100.name: Lindell TE-100

plugin alliance|looptrotter sa2rate2.about: Looptrotter SA2RATE 2 is a saturation processor that adds analog-style harmonics and density to tracks, buses and mixes, with two channels that can work as left/right or mid/side. Drive sets the amount of saturation, Mix blends with the dry signal, and Lo Freq and Hi Freq set the range being saturated; the Magic section (Magic On, Magic Mix) adds a separate coloration. Out Gain and Out Main set levels, and Mono Maker and Stereo Width adjust the stereo image.
plugin alliance|looptrotter sa2rate2.name: Looptrotter SA2RATE2

plugin alliance|ltl chop shop eq.about: LTL Chop Shop EQ is a simple filter EQ with resonant low-cut and high-cut filters, a low Bump, a mid Focus band and a dynamic low-end control (Lo Rider). It is for quick tone shaping and filtering, such as thinning, telephone-style or lo-fi sounds, and controlling bass. Lo Cut On with LoCut Frequency and Hi Cut On with HiCut Frequency (and Hi Cut Res) set the filters, Bump adds low end, Focus with Focus Shift boosts or cuts a mid range, and Lo Rider with Lo Rider Mix controls low-end level dynamically.
plugin alliance|ltl chop shop eq.name: LTL Chop Shop EQ

plugin alliance|maag eq2.about: Maag EQ2 is a two-band EQ with Maag's Air Band high shelf and a low/mid (LMF) band, for adding air and openness or broad low-mid shaping without harshness. Air Frequency and Air Gain set the high lift, and LMF Frequency, LMF Gain and LMF Bandwidth set the low/mid band. Input Attenuation lowers the input level to avoid overload.
plugin alliance|maag eq2.name: Maag EQ2

plugin alliance|maag eq4.about: Maag EQ4 is a six-band EQ with fixed-frequency bands (Sub, 40 Hz, 160 Hz, 650 Hz, 2.5 kHz) and Maag's Air Band high shelf, known for adding smooth top-end air to vocals, mixes and masters. Air Band chooses the air frequency and Air Gain sets the amount; the fixed bands add or remove energy at their frequency. Level Trim sets the output level.
plugin alliance|maag eq4.name: Maag EQ4

plugin alliance|maag magnum-k.about: Maag MAGNUM-K is a compressor/limiter channel with Maag's Air Band and LMF EQ built in, for compression with an open, airy top end on vocals, buses and masters. Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release set the compressor (with K Comp In enabling it), Make Up Gain sets the level, Air Gain/Air Band and LMF Gain/LMF Frequency set the EQ, and Limiter Threshold with Soft Limit catches peaks. Mix blends in the dry signal, and Link ties the two channels together.
plugin alliance|maag magnum-k.name: Maag MAGNUM-K

plugin alliance|millennia nseq-2.about: Millennia NSEQ-2 is a four-band parametric EQ emulation with two channels (or mid and side) and switchable tube or solid-state topology, known for clean, transparent tone shaping on mixes and masters. Each channel has Low, Low-Mid, High-Mid and High bands with their own In/Out, Frequency and Gain; the mid bands add Q, and the outer bands can be shelves (Low Shelf, High Shelf). Topology switches between tube and solid-state character, Gain Range sets the boost/cut range, and Link ties the two channels together.
plugin alliance|millennia nseq-2.name: Millennia NSEQ-2

plugin alliance|millennia tcl-2.about: Millennia TCL-2 is a two-channel compressor emulation with switchable tube or solid-state topology, for smooth leveling on vocals, buses and masters. Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release set the compression per channel, Level sets make-up gain and Mix blends in the dry signal. Topology switches between tube and solid-state character, Stereo Link ties the channels together, and Mid/Side processes mid and side separately.
plugin alliance|millennia tcl-2.name: Millennia TCL-2

plugin alliance|neold big al.about: NEOLD BIG AL is a saturation processor modeled on a vintage tube amplifier circuit, for adding drive and harmonic color from subtle warmth to heavy distortion. Drive sets the amount of saturation and Level sets the output, Low EQ and High EQ shape the tone, and Mix blends with the dry signal. Emphasis, Bass Compensator and Voltage Sag change how the circuit responds.
plugin alliance|neold big al.name: NEOLD BIG AL

plugin alliance|neold u17.about: NEOLD U17 is a compressor with a vintage tube character, for adding density and glue to tracks and buses. Input drives the compressor, Attack Time and Release Time set timing, and Output sets the level; Density and Torque change how strong and colored the compression is. Shape with Frequency filters the detector, Mix blends with the dry signal, and External SC uses a key input.
plugin alliance|neold u17.name: NEOLD U17

plugin alliance|neold v76u73.about: NEOLD V76U73 combines a vintage V76-style tube preamp with a U73-style compressor/limiter, for warm drive and smooth compression on vocals, drums and buses. Gain drives the preamp, Mode selects compress or limit, Attack Time and Release Time set timing, and Makeup Gain restores level. High Cut and Low Cut filter the signal, SC Filter filters the detector, and Mix blends with the dry signal.
plugin alliance|neold v76u73.name: NEOLD V76U73

plugin alliance|neold warble.about: NEOLD WARBLE is a tape-style modulation and degradation effect that adds wow and flutter pitch wobble, dirt, noise and band-limiting. It is for lo-fi, worn-tape textures on keys, guitars, vocals and samples. Wow Depth/Wow Speed and Flutter Depth/Flutter Speed set the pitch wobble, Dirt, Age and Noise add degradation, Low Cut Freq. and High Cut Freq. band-limit the sound, and Mix and Level set the blend and output.
plugin alliance|neold warble.name: NEOLD WARBLE

plugin alliance|noveltech character.about: Noveltech Character is an adaptive enhancer that analyzes the signal and adjusts its tonal balance to add clarity and definition, without manual EQ bands. It is for quickly bringing out detail in tracks or mixes. Character sets the amount of enhancement, Target sets which part of the spectrum is emphasized, and Mode selects the processing type; Input Gain and Output Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|noveltech character.name: Noveltech Character

plugin alliance|noveltech vocal enhancer.about: Noveltech Vocal Enhancer is an adaptive enhancer that analyzes a vocal and dynamically adjusts its tone to improve clarity and intelligibility. It is for making vocals and dialogue sit forward in a mix without manual EQ. Enhancement sets the amount, Focus Frequency sets where the enhancement concentrates, and Strong Processing selects a more aggressive mode; the Low Cut and High Cut controls limit the processed range, and Gain Comp keeps output level matched.
plugin alliance|noveltech vocal enhancer.name: Noveltech Vocal Enhancer

plugin alliance|pro audio dsp dsm v3.about: Pro Audio DSP DSM V3 is a multiband dynamics processor that compresses or expands against a captured spectral profile, so it can rebalance a mix's tone dynamically as well as control level. It is used on mixes and masters for loudness and tonal consistency. Capture learns the profile from the audio, Threshold with Compressor Ratio or Expander Ratio sets the main dynamics, Attack and Release set timing, and the three In/Frequency/Threshold/Q groups adjust specific regions. Master Wet/Dry blends the dry signal, Limiter In adds a final limiter, and Master Out Gain sets the output.
plugin alliance|pro audio dsp dsm v3.name: Pro Audio DSP DSM V3

plugin alliance|purple audio mc 77.about: Purple Audio MC 77 is an emulation of Purple Audio's 1176-style FET compressor/limiter, for fast, punchy compression on vocals, drums, bass and guitars. Input drives the compressor (more input means more compression), Output sets the level, Ratio selects the ratio, and Attack and Release set timing, each per channel (L and R). Link ties the channels, Mix blends the dry signal for parallel compression, and SC HP Freq keeps low end from driving the detector.
plugin alliance|purple audio mc 77.name: Purple Audio MC 77

plugin alliance|schoeps double ms.about: Schoeps Double MS is a decoder that turns a double mid/side microphone recording (front mid, rear mid and a shared side mic) into a 5.1 surround mix. It is for producing surround from a double-MS recording with adjustable virtual microphone patterns after the fact. polar_pattern_lr, polar_pattern_c and polar_pattern_lsrs set the virtual pickup patterns, microphone_angle_lr and microphone_angle_lsrs set the angles of the virtual microphones, and gain_lr, gain_c, gain_lsrs and ambience_gain balance the channels; surround_delay and surround_lowpass shape the rear channels.
plugin alliance|schoeps double ms.name: Schoeps Double MS

plugin alliance|schoeps mono upmix 1to2.about: Schoeps Mono Upmix 1to2 creates a natural-sounding stereo signal from a mono source by adding a decorrelated spatial component. It is for widening mono recordings such as dialogue, archival audio or mono instruments. upmix_gain sets how much of the generated stereo component is added, depth sets the spatial impression, pan places the source, and brilliance and divergence adjust the high-frequency content and spread.
plugin alliance|schoeps mono upmix 1to2.name: Schoeps Mono Upmix 1to2

plugin alliance|schoeps mono upmix 1to3.about: Schoeps Mono Upmix 1to3 creates a three-channel (left, center, right) output from a mono source by adding a decorrelated spatial component. It is for widening mono recordings for LCR or surround mixes. upmix_gain sets how much of the generated spatial component is added, depth sets the spatial impression, pan places the source, and brilliance and divergence adjust the high-frequency content and spread.
plugin alliance|schoeps mono upmix 1to3.name: Schoeps Mono Upmix 1to3

plugin alliance|shadow hills class a mas.about: Shadow Hills Class A Mastering Comp is a two-stage mastering compressor with an optical stage and a discrete VCA-style stage in series, plus selectable output transformers for color. It is for glue and smooth density on masters and mix buses. Optical Threshold and Optical Gain set the optical stage, Discrete Threshold, Discrete Ratio, Discrete Attack, Discrete Recover and Discrete Gain set the discrete stage, and Transformer selects Nickel, Iron or Steel coloration. Mode sets stereo, dual mono or mid/side, Sidechain HP Freq filters the detector, and Mix blends the dry signal.
plugin alliance|shadow hills class a mas.name: Shadow Hills Class A Mastering Comp

plugin alliance|shadow hills mastering c.about: Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor is a two-stage mastering compressor with an optical stage and a discrete VCA-style stage in series, plus selectable output transformers for color. It is for glue and smooth density on masters and mix buses. Optical Threshold and Optical Gain set the optical stage, Discrete Threshold, Discrete Ratio, Discrete Attack, Discrete Recover and Discrete Gain set the discrete stage, and Transformer selects Nickel, Iron or Steel coloration. Mode sets stereo, dual mono or mid/side, Sidechain HP Freq filters the detector, and Mix blends the dry signal.
plugin alliance|shadow hills mastering c.name: Shadow Hills Mastering Compressor

plugin alliance|spl attacker plus.about: SPL Attacker Plus is a transient shaper that only boosts or reduces the attack of sounds, independent of their level. It is for adding punch to drums and percussion or softening hard attacks. Attack sets the amount (positive for more punch, negative for softer hits), Output sets the level and Mix blends with the dry signal; Limit engages an output limiter to catch the extra peaks.
plugin alliance|spl attacker plus.name: SPL Attacker Plus

plugin alliance|spl de-esser.about: SPL De-Esser is an automatic de-esser that detects and reduces sibilance without needing a threshold setting. It is for taming harsh S sounds on vocals and speech. S-Reduction sets how much sibilance is reduced, Filter selects male or female voice tuning, and Mode chooses left/right or mid/side processing.
plugin alliance|spl de-esser.name: SPL De-Esser

plugin alliance|spl de-esser dual-band.about: SPL De-Esser Dual-Band is an automatic de-esser with two sibilance bands that can be reduced separately, without a threshold setting. It is for taming harsh S sounds on vocals and speech, including sibilance spread over a wide range. Low-Band On and High-Band On enable each band, Low S-Reduction and High S-Reduction set how much each is reduced, Filter selects male or female voice tuning, and Mode chooses left/right or mid/side processing.
plugin alliance|spl de-esser dual-band.name: SPL De-Esser Dual-Band

plugin alliance|spl de-verb plus.about: SPL De-Verb Plus is a transient-based processor that reduces the sustain of a signal to make room reverb and ambience less prominent. It is for drier-sounding vocals, dialogue and drum recordings made in reverberant rooms. De-Verb sets how much the tail is reduced, Mix blends with the dry signal, Output sets the level, and Limit engages an output limiter.
plugin alliance|spl de-verb plus.name: SPL De-Verb Plus

plugin alliance|spl drumxchanger.about: SPL DrumXchanger is a drum replacement plug-in that detects hits in a drum track and triggers samples from its library, either replacing or layering with the original. It is for strengthening or swapping kick, snare and tom sounds. Trigger Frequency, Trigger Q and Trigger Threshold (with Transient Threshold) set what triggers a sample, Kit Select and Piece Select choose the sample, and Tune, Dynamics and the Playback filter and envelope controls shape it; Dry/Wet Mix balances the original and the sample.
plugin alliance|spl drumxchanger.name: SPL DrumXchanger

plugin alliance|spl eq ranger plus.about: SPL EQ Ranger Plus is a graphic-style EQ with eight fixed bands whose frequency layout is set by Module (for example a full-range or bass-focused layout). It is for quick, broad tonal shaping by boosting or cutting fixed bands. Band 1 to Band 8 set each band's gain, Module chooses the band layout, and Output Gain sets the level.
plugin alliance|spl eq ranger plus.name: SPL EQ Ranger Plus

plugin alliance|spl free ranger.about: SPL Free Ranger is a simple four-band EQ with fixed frequencies at 40 Hz, 150 Hz, 1.8 kHz and 16 kHz. It is for quick, broad tone shaping: low-end weight, low-mid warmth or mud, presence, and air. Band 40, Band 150, Band 1k8 and Band 16k boost or cut their bands, and Output sets the level.
plugin alliance|spl free ranger.name: SPL Free Ranger

plugin alliance|spl iron.about: SPL IRON is a tube mastering compressor with selectable rectifier types and sidechain EQ, for smooth, colored compression on masters and mix buses. Threshold, Attack and Release set the compression per channel, Tube Bias changes the compression character, Rectifier selects the rectifier behavior, and Side Chain EQ shapes what drives the detector. Link ties the channels, Mix blends the dry signal, and Input and Output set gain staging.
plugin alliance|spl iron.name: SPL IRON

plugin alliance|spl mo-verb plus.about: SPL Mo-Verb Plus is a transient-based processor that increases the sustain of a signal to bring out the room sound and ambience already in a recording; it does not add artificial reverb. It is for making dry drum or room recordings sound more spacious. Mo-Verb sets how much the sustain is raised, Mix blends with the dry signal, Output sets the level, and Limit engages an output limiter.
plugin alliance|spl mo-verb plus.name: SPL Mo-Verb Plus

plugin alliance|spl passeq.about: SPL Passeq is a passive EQ with two channels (or mid and side), each with separate boost and cut bands for lows, mids and highs, for smooth, musical tone shaping on mixes and masters. Per channel, LB/LB-f and LC/LC-f boost and cut the low end, MB/MB-f and MC/MC-f the mids, and HB/HB-f (with HB-Q) and HC/HC-f the highs. Output sets each channel's level, and Link ties the two channels together.
plugin alliance|spl passeq.name: SPL Passeq

plugin alliance|spl passeq single.about: SPL Passeq Single is a one-channel version of the SPL Passeq passive EQ, with separate boost and cut bands for lows, mids and highs, for smooth, musical tone shaping. LB/LB-f and LC/LC-f boost and cut the low end, MB/MB-f and MC/MC-f the mids, and HB/HB-f (with HB-Q) and HC/HC-f the highs. Output sets the level.
plugin alliance|spl passeq single.name: SPL Passeq Single

plugin alliance|spl pq.about: SPL PQ is a five-band parametric mastering EQ with high- and low-pass filters, separate left and right (or mid and side) channels, and stereo tools. It is for precise, clean tone shaping on masters and mixes. Each band (LoF, LMF, MiF, HMF, HiF) has Power, Freq, Gain and Q controls per channel, HP Freq and LP Freq set the filters, and Link ties the channels. Mono Maker narrows the bass below Monomaker Freq and Stereowidth adjusts width.
plugin alliance|spl pq.name: SPL PQ

plugin alliance|spl transient designer p.about: SPL Transient Designer Plus is a transient shaper that boosts or reduces the attack and sustain of sounds independently of their level. It is for adding punch to drums, softening hard attacks, or shortening or lengthening room sound. Attack sets the punch (positive for more, negative for softer) and Sustain sets the tail (positive for more room, negative for tighter); Output sets the level, Mix blends with the dry signal, Limit catches peaks, and the SC Freq/SC Filter On controls focus detection on part of the spectrum.
plugin alliance|spl transient designer p.name: SPL Transient Designer Plus

plugin alliance|spl twintube.about: SPL TwinTube is a saturation processor that adds tube-style harmonics in two stages: Saturation for overall warmth and density, and Harmonics for added overtones above a chosen frequency. It is for warming and thickening vocals, instruments and buses. Saturation sets the drive, Harmonics sets the amount of added overtones and Harmonics Frequency where they start; Harmonics On and Saturation On switch each stage, and Output sets the level.
plugin alliance|spl twintube.name: SPL TwinTube

plugin alliance|spl vitalizer mk2-t.about: SPL Vitalizer MK2-T is a psychoacoustic tone enhancer that adds clarity, low-end punch and width without conventional EQ bands. It is for brightening and adding definition to mixes, masters or individual tracks. Drive sets input level, Bass Sound and Bass Compression shape the low end, Mid-Hi Tune sets the frequency for the high-end processing with Process controlling its amount, LC-EQ and Intensity control the high-frequency enhancement, and Stereo Expander widens the image; Output Gain sets the level.
plugin alliance|spl vitalizer mk2-t.name: SPL Vitalizer MK2-T

plugin alliance|suhr pt100.about: Suhr PT100 is a guitar amp simulation of the Suhr PT100 three-channel head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for clean to high-gain tones. Channels Selection chooses the channel; channel 1 uses Gain 1, Bass 1, Middle 1, Treble 1 and Level 1 (with Crunch and Bright 1), and channels 2 and 3 share Bass 23, Middle 23 and Treble 23 with their own Gain and Level. Boost adds drive, and Presence and Depth shape the power amp. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|suhr pt100.name: Suhr PT100

plugin alliance|suhr se100.about: Suhr SE100 is a guitar amp simulation of the Suhr SE100 head, with preamp, power amp and cabinet/microphone modeling, for crunch to high-gain rock tones. Gain sets the drive, Bass, Middle, Treble and Presence shape the tone, and Level sets the amp output. Most Plugin Alliance amp models share the same outer section: Input Gain or Input, Power Soak, Recording Chain (cabinet and microphone), a noise gate (NoiseGate ByPass, NoiseGate Thres, NoiseGate Range), a simple delay, and Tight/Smooth filters that trim lows and highs.
plugin alliance|suhr se100.name: Suhr SE100

plugin alliance|tbtech kirchhoff-eq.about: TBTECH Kirchhoff-EQ is a parametric EQ with up to 32 bands, each optionally dynamic, with filter types, stereo placement (left, right, mid or side) per band. It is for surgical and corrective EQ, such as removing resonances or applying EQ only when a frequency gets loud. For each band, Band Type, Freq., Gain and Q set the filter, Stereo Placement chooses which channels it affects, and Dyn. On with Dyn. Threshold, Attack and Release make it dynamic; Master Vol. sets the output and Enable Auto Gain keeps level matched.
plugin alliance|tbtech kirchhoff-eq.name: TBTECH Kirchhoff-EQ

plugin alliance|tomo audiolabs lisa.about: TOMO Audiolabs LISA is a dynamic EQ with four parametric bands (LO, LM, HM, HI) plus low and high filter bands (LB, HB) per channel, each of which can act statically or dynamically, plus transformer coloration. It is for tone shaping and controlling frequency ranges that only become a problem at loud moments, on vocals, mixes and masters. Each band has On, Gain, Freq, Q and Cut/Bst controls, with Dyn. On and Thld making it dynamic; LoCut Freq removes low end, TX Drive adds saturation, and Mid Side and Stereo Width handle stereo processing.
plugin alliance|tomo audiolabs lisa.name: TOMO Audiolabs LISA

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio bass mi.about: Unfiltered Audio Bass Mint is a bass enhancer that adds harmonics and tightens low end so bass is heard more clearly, including on small speakers. It is for bass guitars, synth bass, kicks and mixes. Mode selects the enhancement type, Cutoff sets the frequency below which the bass is processed, and Strength sets the amount; Clarity, Soften and Soft Clip shape the result, Anti Rumble removes sub-low content, Mono Bass makes the bass mono, and Out Gain sets the level.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio bass mi.name: Unfiltered Audio Bass Mint

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio byome.about: Unfiltered Audio BYOME is a modular multi-effect where effect modules (delay, distortion, filter, modulation, pitch, reverb and more) are chained in the plug-in's own interface. It is for sound design and creative effects, usually starting from a preset. From the host, the Macro 1 to Macro 8 controls change whatever each preset assigns them to, Dry/Wet blends the effect, AGC keeps level steady, and In Gain and Out Gain set levels.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio byome.name: Unfiltered Audio Byome

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio dent 2.about: Unfiltered Audio Dent 2 is a distortion and degradation effect combining waveshaping, bitcrushing, sample-rate reduction, filtering and random signal drops. It is for lo-fi textures, grit, and glitchy effects on drums, synths and vocals. In Gain and Shape set the distortion, Sample Rate and Bits set the digital degradation, Cutoff and Resonance (with Filter Type) shape the tone, and Probability with Drop Mode adds random dropouts; Dry/Wet and Output Trim set the blend and level.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio dent 2.name: Unfiltered Audio Dent 2

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio fault.about: Unfiltered Audio Fault is a stereo glitch effect that pitches, delays, modulates, and feeds sound back into itself for broken, textured results. It suits experimental vocals, drums, bass, transitions, and sound design needing controlled chaos, echoes, or unstable movement. Use Input Gain and Output Gain for level; set Dry/Wet 30-50% for blends or 100% for full effect. With Tempo Sync On, set Delay L Time and Delay R Time to 1/8th or 1/16th. Use small Pitch Shift L and Pitch Shift R values, with Quantize PShifter On for musical detunes; larger values create chaos, and Link P. Shift Off detunes stereo. Lower Sample Rate for coarser timbres; modulate Shift Amount, FM Freq Mult, or FM Depth for movement. Add Shift L FB or Delay L FB around 20-50%, then shape feedback with LP Cutoff or HP Cutoff.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio fault.name: Unfiltered Audio Fault

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio g8.about: Unfiltered Audio G8 is a multi-channel dynamic gate that mutes or reduces material below Threshold, using RMS-Peak detection, Hysteresis, and per-channel filtering. It suits cleaning noise, tightening drums, gating reverb or synths, and creating rhythmic cuts. For common noise-gating jobs set Threshold just above the noise floor, Attack 1-10 ms, Release 100-300 ms, Hold 0-100 ms, Reduction deep for muting or 10-30 dB for soft gating, and Hysteresis 3-10 dB to stop retriggering. Use RMS-Peak at RMS for level-based cuts, Peak for fast transients, and Lookahead 5-20 ms for tight starts. Keep Link 1 + 2 active for stereo pairs, use Sidechain plus Channel 1 LP and Channel 1 HP when needed, and set Behavior to Cycle with Cycle Delay for pattern timing.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio g8.name: Unfiltered Audio G8

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio indent.about: Unfiltered Audio Indent 2 is a distortion plug-in that drives the signal into clipping stages placed before and after a resonant filter. It is good for adding grit, crunch or hard-clipped aggression to drums, bass, synths and guitars. In Gain sets how hard the signal is driven, Clip Mode In and Clip Mode Out choose the clipping character of each stage, and Cutoff, Filter Type and Resonance shape the tone between them. Use Gain Compensation or Out Gain and Output Trim to match levels, and Dry/Wet for parallel distortion.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio indent.name: Unfiltered Audio Indent 2

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio instant.about: Unfiltered Audio Instant Delay is a simple stereo delay with feedback, drive, a resonant filter and timing jitter. It is good for quick rhythmic echoes, dub-style filtered repeats and slightly unstable, wobbly delays. Set Delay Time (with Tempo Sync for note values) and Feedback for the number of repeats; Spread Mode and Delay R Time give different left and right times for width. Filter, Filter Mode and Resonance color the repeats, Drive adds saturation, Jitter adds pitch and time wobble, and Dry/Wet sets the blend.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio instant.name: Unfiltered Audio Instant Delay

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio lo-fi-a.about: Unfiltered Audio lo-fi-af is a degradation plug-in that makes audio sound old, broken or low quality, combining analog, digital, spectral and convolution damage sections. It is good for lo-fi beats, tape or radio textures, telephone and small-speaker sounds, MP3-style artifacts and glitchy skips. Turn sections on with Enable Analog, Enable Digital, Enable Spectral and Enable Convolution; Bits, S.Rate and MP3 give digital damage, Noise and Noise Mode add hiss and crackle, Convolution chooses a speaker or device character, and Skip Chance and Skip Time add skipping. Global Strength scales all damage at once, and Mix blends the result with the dry signal.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio lo-fi-a.name: Unfiltered Audio lo-fi-af

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio needlep.about: Unfiltered Audio Needlepoint is a vinyl record simulator that adds surface noise, dust crackle and pops, wow and flutter, and turntable spin-down. It is good for giving music a vintage record character or for effects such as a record slowing to a stop. Mode chooses the playback character and RPM the record speed; Noise Level, Small Dust, Medium Dust and Large Dust with their Density controls set the amount of crackle, and Wow and Flutter set pitch wobble. Age, Compression and Strength control how worn the result sounds, and Spindown with Spindown Time produces a slow-down effect.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio needlep.name: Unfiltered Audio Needlepoint

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio sandman.about: Unfiltered Audio Sandman is a creative delay whose Sleep control freezes the delay buffer so a slice of audio can be looped, scrubbed and played back with different start and end points. It is good for echo, stutters, frozen loops and glitchy rhythmic textures. Delay Time (with Tempo Sync) and Feedback set ordinary echoes, Sleep holds the buffer, and Start Time and End Time choose the slice that plays while frozen. Sample Rate and Dirt add lo-fi degradation, Filter shapes the repeats, Ping Pong spreads them across the stereo field, and the two LFOs can modulate delay time, slice points, sample rate and feedback.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio sandman.name: Unfiltered Audio Sandman

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio sandman.about: Unfiltered Audio Sandman Pro is an expanded version of Sandman, a multi-mode creative delay with buffer freezing (Sleep), reverse, multi-tap, pitch and tape-style modes and a modulation system. It is good for tape echoes, ping-pong and multi-tap rhythms, frozen loops, reversed or pitched repeats and ambient, diffused delays. Delay Mode picks the delay algorithm; Delay Time (with Tempo Sync), Feedback and X-Feedback set the echoes, and Sleep, Start Time and End Time freeze and loop a slice. Dirt/Saturate, Wow/Jitter, Pitch/Glitch L and R and Diffusion color the repeats, LP Cutoff and HP Cutoff filter them, and Dry/Wet and Stereo Width set the blend.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio sandman.name: Unfiltered Audio Sandman Pro

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio silo.about: Unfiltered Audio Silo is a granular effect that chops incoming audio into small grains, then scatters them in stereo space with a spatializer and adds reverb. It is good for evolving pads, ambient textures, shimmering clouds of sound and glitchy reinterpretations of a source. Size and Rate set grain length and density, Pitch and Speed transpose and stretch the grains, Reverse and Freeze give reversed or held textures, and the Deviation controls add randomness. Spatializer On with Locations, Range and Velocity moves grains around, Reverb On with Reverb Level and Decay adds space, and Mix sets the blend.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio silo.name: Unfiltered Audio Silo

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio specops.about: Unfiltered Audio SpecOps is a spectral (FFT-based) effects processor that can freeze, pitch-shift, stretch, filter and compress audio in the frequency domain. It is good for frozen drones, smeared pads, spectral filtering and experimental sound design on vocals, drums or whole loops. Freeze holds the current spectrum and Speed slows or speeds playback, Pitch Shift and Stretch alter pitch and harmonic spacing, and Filter 1, Filter 2 and Filter 3 with their modes, Start and Width settings apply spectral effects to chosen frequency ranges. FFTSize trades time resolution for frequency resolution, and Dry/Wet blends the result.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio specops.name: Unfiltered Audio SpecOps

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio tails.about: Unfiltered Audio Tails is a creative reverb that combines several reverb algorithms with pitch, saturation and buffer effects, plus ducking and MIDI gating of the tail. It is good for ambient and shimmering spaces, reverbs that stay out of the way of the dry signal, and rhythmic, gated or retriggered reverb effects. Reverb Mode chooses the reverb type, Decay, Damping, Tone and Distance shape the space, and Pitch and Feedback create shimmer-like tails. Enable Ducking with Sensitivity lowers the reverb while the source plays, MIDI Gate and MIDI Mute control the tail from MIDI notes, and Mix sets the balance.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio tails.name: Unfiltered Audio Tails

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio triad.about: Unfiltered Audio TRIAD is a multiband multi-effect that splits audio into low, mid and high bands and runs each band through its own chain of effect modules. It is good for processing frequency ranges differently, such as distorting only the mids, delaying only the highs or widening one band, and for complex sound design. LowFreqCutoff and HighFreqCutoff set the crossover points, Slope sets the crossover steepness, Low Gain, Mid Gain and High Gain balance the bands, and Low Enabled, Mid Enabled and High Enabled switch them. The effects inside each band are chosen in the plug-in's own interface; Macro 1 to Macro 32 are assignable macro controls, and Dry/Wet blends the output.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio triad.name: Unfiltered Audio Triad

plugin alliance|unfiltered audio zip.about: Unfiltered Audio Zip is a compressor and expander that can follow either the level of the signal or how tonal (pitched) it is, with an added color stage. It is good for normal level control, punchy or pumping compression, and creative ducking of tonal or noisy parts of a sound. Threshold (or Auto Threshold), Ratio, Knee, Attack and Release set the dynamics, Analysis Mode chooses what is detected, and Expand turns it into an expander. Color and Color Mode add character, AGC keeps the output level steady, and Dry/Wet allows parallel compression.
plugin alliance|unfiltered audio zip.name: Unfiltered Audio Zip

plugin alliance|vertigo vsc-2.about: Vertigo VSC-2 is a model of the Vertigo Sound VSC-2 quad discrete stereo bus compressor, known for clean, punchy glue on mixes and groups. It is good for mix bus and drum bus compression, mastering, and gentle level control on stereo sources. Threshold A, Ratio A, Attack A, Release A and Make Up A set the compression (the B controls apply when the channels are unlinked), Link ties the two channels together, and SC Filter A and SC Filter B high-pass the detector so heavy bass does not drive the compressor. Gain Reduction A and Gain Reduction B show how much it is compressing.
plugin alliance|vertigo vsc-2.name: Vertigo VSC-2

plugin alliance|vertigo vsm-3.about: Vertigo VSM-3 is a model of the Vertigo Sound VSM-3 mix satellite, a harmonic saturation unit with two distortion stages, the FET Crusher and the Zener Blender. It is good for adding harmonics, density and presence to mixes, buses, drums, bass and vocals, from subtle coloration to obvious grit. FET Crusher Drive and Zener Blender Drive set how much each stage saturates, with Level, Input Filter, Shape and Style shaping their character, and FET Crusher Mode and Zener Blender Mode can apply them to mid or side signals. THD Mixer Mix blends the distortion with the clean signal, and Output Gain L and Output Gain R set the final level.
plugin alliance|vertigo vsm-3.name: Vertigo VSM-3

polyverse music|comet.about: Polyverse Comet is an algorithmic reverb for anything from small spaces to very long, lush tails. It is good for vocals, synths, pads, drums and ambient sound design. Size and Decay set the space and its length, Pre Delay separates the reverb from the dry sound, Diffuse controls density, and Low Damp, High Damp and Color shape its tone. Detune and Glide add movement, Preset Morph moves between stored settings, and Dry Wet sets the blend.
polyverse music|comet.name: Comet

polyverse music|i wish.about: Polyverse I Wish is a pitch-freezing effect that captures the incoming sound and holds it as a sustained, pitch-shiftable tone, played from MIDI notes or the pitch wheel. It is good for turning a moment of a vocal or instrument into playable pads and leads, whammy-style pitch bends and frozen glitch effects. Pitch and Formant set the shift, PitchWheelUp and PitchWheelDown set the bend range, and Glide and Smooth soften pitch changes. PitchLFO, FormantLFO, PitchENV and FormantENV add movement, Polyphony sets how many notes can play, and Wet sets the blend.
polyverse music|i wish.name: I Wish

polyverse music|manipulator.about: Polyverse Manipulator is a real-time vocal and monophonic sound transformer that changes pitch, formant and harmonic content to create robotic, alien, choir-like or synth-like voices. It is good for creative vocal effects and sound design on monophonic sources. Pitch and Formant shift the voice and its character, Harmonics, Ratio, FM, Alternator and Octave reshape the harmonic content, and Detune, Smear, Glide and Smooth soften or thicken it. Stereo widens the result and Wetdry blends it with the dry signal; the _mod parameters set how much each modulation slot affects a control.
polyverse music|manipulator.name: Manipulator

quikquak|pitchwheel.about: QuikQuak Pitchwheel is a pitch and timbre shifting effect that changes the pitch of a sound and, separately, its timbre or formant character. It is good for pitch-shifted vocals and instruments, retuned sounds and gliding pitch effects. Pitch and Timbre set the shifts, Pitch Range and Timbre Range set how far they can move, and Pitch Snap and Timbre Snap lock changes to steps. Pitch Smooth, Pitch Inertia and Pitch Gravity (and the Timbre equivalents) control how changes glide, and mixer blends the processed and dry signals.
quikquak|pitchwheel.name: Pitchwheel

rob papen|delgrain.about: Rob Papen DelGrain is a stereo delay combined with a granular effect, plus filters, distortion and the Disrupt randomizing system. It is good for synced echoes, grainy textured repeats, rhythmic stutters and evolving ambient delays. Left Delay, Right Delay (with Delay Tempo Sync On/Off), Feedback and Cross Feedback set the echoes, and Grain Size, Grain Semi and Grain Mix control the granular layer. Filter Mode with HighPass Filter, LowPass Filter, BandPass Filter or Vox Filter shapes the sound, Lazy Mode and the Disrupt controls add movement and randomness, and Wet/Dry Mix sets the blend.
rob papen|delgrain.name: DelGrain

rob papen|delsane.about: Rob Papen DelSane is a creative stereo delay with filters, frequency shifting, distortion, an envelope follower and the Disrupt system for randomizing settings in time with the music. It is good for synced echoes, ping-pong and cross-feedback delays, and evolving or glitchy delay effects. Left Delay, Right Delay (with Delay Tempo Sync On/Off), Feedback and Cross Feedback set the repeats, High-Pass/Vowel Frequency and Low-Pass/Vowel Frequency filter them, and Frequency Shift and Distortion Amount color them. Disrupt Amount and the Disrupt > destination switches control how much settings jump around, and Wet/Dry Mix sets the blend.
rob papen|delsane.name: DelSane

rob papen|lowsane.about: Rob Papen LowSane is a distortion and lo-fi multi-effect combining saturation, a band-pass/notch filter, bit and sample-rate reduction, filters, a noise gate and the Disrupt modulation system. It is good for grit on drums, bass and synths, crushed lo-fi textures and changing, glitchy distortion. Distort On and Saturate Distort set the drive, Lo-Fi Bits and Lo-Fi Rate add digital degradation, and High Pass Frequency, Low Pass Frequency and the BandPass/Notch controls shape the tone. The Disrupt controls add rhythmic or random changes, and Wet/Dry Mix and Main Volume set blend and level.
rob papen|lowsane.name: LowSane

rob papen|mastermagic.about: Rob Papen MasterMagic is a mastering processor; the controls exposed here are an Air high-frequency enhancer and a mono/stereo split that makes the low end mono below a set frequency. It is good for adding top-end sheen to a mix and tightening the bass by collapsing it to mono. Air On / Off with Air Amount and Air Frequency control the brightness lift, and Mono / Stereo Split On / Off with Mono / Stereo Split Frequency sets the point below which the signal is made mono; Mono / Stereo Split Solo On / Off lets you hear only the affected part. Main Volume sets the output level; most other controls appear only as internal parameters.
rob papen|mastermagic.name: MasterMagic

rob papen|revsane.about: RevSane is Rob Papen's reverb plug-in that adds room reflections and decaying tails, with optional early/late stages, filtering, distortion, and disruption modulation. It suits vocal, drum, guitar, and synth ambience, from short rooms to large halls, and creative glitchy spaces. Start with Reverb Preset, then set Wet/Dry Mix to 30-50% and Main Volume to taste. For rooms, use Reverb Length 0.6-1.2 sec, Reverb Room Size low to medium, and Reverb Damp 20-40%; for halls, use Reverb Length 2-5 sec and Reverb Room Size high. Set Reverb Pre-Delay 20-40 ms for vocals, 0-15 ms for drums, Reverb HP Frequency 100-300 Hz to clear lows, and Reverb LP Frequency 6-12 kHz to soften highs. Adjust Early Length and Early Volume for near detail, Late Length and Late Volume for tail shape, add Distortion Amount sparingly, and use Disrupt Value for movement.
rob papen|revsane.name: RevSane

rob papen|rocoder.about: Rob Papen RoCoder is a vocoder: it imposes the spectral shape of a modulator signal, usually a voice, onto a carrier from its built-in synth oscillator or another input, giving robot and talking-synth sounds. It is good for robotic vocals, talking synths and rhythmic vocoded textures. Modulator Center Frequency, Modulator Frequency Spread and Modulator Band-Width set the analysis bands, Modulator Follower Attack and Modulator Follower Decay how fast it tracks the voice, and the Carrier controls the synthesis bands. The Oscillator controls set the internal carrier synth, Vocoder/Additive Mix chooses between vocoding and additive resynthesis, and Dry Volume and Wet Volume set the blend.
rob papen|rocoder.name: RoCoder

rob papen|rp-amod.about: Rob Papen RP-AMod is a modulation multi-effect with two effect slots (such as chorus, flanger, phaser or tape flanger) that can run in parallel or be split across a frequency band. It is good for chorus and flanging on synths, guitars and pads, and for applying modulation only to the high or low part of a sound. Fx 1 Type and Fx 2 Type choose the effects, Mode and Split Frequency set how the slots are combined, and each slot's Length, Width, Speed and Feedback controls shape the modulation, with Tempo Sync Fx 1 and Tempo Sync Fx 2 locking it to the song. Main Mix sets the wet/dry balance and Main Volume the level.
rob papen|rp-amod.name: RP-AMod

rob papen|rp-delay.about: Rob Papen RP-Delay is a multi-line stereo delay with up to six independently set delay lines, each with its own times, feedback, panning and filters. It is good for complex rhythmic echoes, ping-pong and multi-tap patterns, and dub-style delays. Global Length and Global Feedback scale all lines, the Delay 1A to 2C Left Len, Right Len, Feed and Cross-Feed controls set each line's timing and repeats, and their Pan, LP Freq and HP Freq controls place and filter them. EQ Low, EQ Mid and EQ High shape the overall sound, and Mix and Volume set the blend and level.
rob papen|rp-delay.name: RP-Delay

rob papen|rp-distort.about: Rob Papen RP-Distort is a distortion multi-effect with several distortion types plus a lo-fi stage, EQ, filters, compressor, noise gate, stereo widener and modulation. It is good for driving drums, bass, synths and guitars, from warm saturation to crushed lo-fi sounds. Distort Type chooses the distortion and Distort sets its amount; the low-fi: bits and low-fi: s&h controls add digital degradation, and EQ Low, EQ Mid 1, EQ Mid 2, EQ High and the LP and HP Filter Frequency controls shape the tone. Compressor and Noise-Gate tame the result, and Wet Dry / Mix and Distort Volume set blend and level.
rob papen|rp-distort.name: RP-Distort

rob papen|rp-distort2.about: Rob Papen RP-Distort2 is a distortion multi-effect with selectable distortion algorithms, pre- and post-distortion EQs, filters, a noise gate and a compressor. It is good for anything from gentle saturation to heavy, aggressive distortion on drums, bass, guitars and synths. Distort: Amount and Distort: Pre-Boost set the drive, Distort: Frequency adjusts the distortion character, and Pre-EQ shapes what is distorted while Post-EQ, High-Pass Filter Frequency and Low-Pass Filter Frequency shape the result. Compressor On and Noise-Gate On control dynamics, and Wet/Dry Mix and Volume set blend and level.
rob papen|rp-distort2.name: RP-Distort2

rob papen|rp-eq.about: Rob Papen RP-EQ is a multi-band parametric equalizer with per-band solo and lock controls. It is good for general tone shaping: cutting rumble and mud, adding presence or air, and notching resonances. Each band has an On / Off switch, Frequency (or a musical Note value via Frequency / Note), Gain and BandWidth; Solo On / Off and Band-Pass Solo let you hear only the area a band affects. EQ On / Off switches the whole EQ, and Main Volume sets the output level.
rob papen|rp-eq.name: RP-EQ

rob papen|rp-pan.about: Rob Papen RP-Pan is an auto-panner that moves the sound between left and right using the Disrupt system, with an optional Doppler effect. It is good for animated stereo movement on synths, percussion and effects, from slow drifting to rhythmic jumps. Disrupt Amount sets how far the sound moves, Disrupt Quantization and Disrupt Spring Time set the rhythm and smoothness of the changes, and Disrupt Lazy Mode On with Disrupt Lazy Mode Speed gives slower, continuous movement. Doppler On with Doppler Amount and Doppler Volume Amount adds pitch and level changes like a passing sound source.
rob papen|rp-pan.name: RP-PAN

rob papen|rp-reverse.about: Rob Papen RP-Reverse is a reverse effect that captures incoming audio and plays it back backwards, either triggered by the input level or in time with the song. It is good for reversed swells into hits, backward vocals and guitar, and transition effects. Reverse Length (with Reverse Tempo Sync) sets how much audio is reversed, Reverse Trigger Mode and Reverse Trigger Threshold control when it fires, and Reverse Attack and Reverse Decay shape the fades. LowPass Filter Frequency, HighPass Filter Frequency, Distort and the LFO controls color the result, and Dry Volume and Wet Volume set the blend.
rob papen|rp-reverse.name: RP-Reverse

rob papen|rp-verb.about: Rob Papen RP-Verb is an algorithmic stereo reverb with diffusion, ensemble modulation, EQ, an envelope (gate) section and optional distortion. It is good for rooms, halls and long ambient tails on vocals, drums and synths, and for gated or swelling reverbs. Room Size and Length set the space and decay time, Pre-Delay separates the reverb from the dry sound, and Damp, Low Color and High Color shape its tone. Envelope with Envelope Attack, Envelope Hold and Envelope Release gates or swells the reverb, Ensemble adds movement, and Wet / Dry sets the blend.
rob papen|rp-verb.name: RP-Verb

rob papen|rp-verb2.about: Rob Papen RP-Verb2 is an algorithmic stereo reverb with separate early-reflection, main reverb and late-reflection sections, plus ensemble, distortion and EQ. It is good for vocals, drums, guitars and synths, from small rooms to long ambient tails. Reverb Room Size, Reverb Length and Reverb Pre-Delay set the space, Reverb Damping, Reverb HP Frequency and Reverb LP Frequency shape its tone, and Reverb Diffusion sets its density. Early Volume and Early Length control the first reflections and Late Volume and Late Length the later ones, and Wet / Dry Mix sets the blend.
rob papen|rp-verb2.name: RP-Verb2

rob papen|unimagic.about: Rob Papen UniMagic is a stereo thickening effect that layers choruses and pitch-shifting voices to make a sound wider and fuller, similar to synth unison. It is good for widening synths, pads, guitars and vocals, and for detuned, doubled textures. Amount sets the overall effect depth; the Chorus 1 and Chorus 2 controls (Speed, Width, Spread, Mix) set the chorus layers, and Shift 1 Left Semi, Shift 1 Right Semi and the Fine controls set detuned pitch-shifted voices. 75Hz LowCut keeps the low end clean, and Main Volume sets the level.
rob papen|unimagic.name: UniMagic

rob papen|xy-transfer.about: Rob Papen XY-Transfer is a multi-effect built from processing blocks (filter, comb filter, waveshaper and lo-fi, room, gater) whose settings can be morphed with an X/Y pad. It is good for animated sound design, moving filters and textures, and performance-style changes on loops and synths. Path sets how the blocks are routed, each block's controls such as Block 1 Filter Freq, Block 1 Comb Freq, Block 1 Shaper Amount and Block 1 Room Length shape its sound, and the X and Y assignments decide which settings the pad moves. Block 1 Mix, Block 1 Volume and Block 1 Spread (and the same for other blocks) set each block's blend, level and width.
rob papen|xy-transfer.name: XY-Transfer

soundtoys|crystallizer.about: Soundtoys Crystallizer is a granular reverse-echo effect that slices audio into pieces, pitch-shifts and can reverse them, then repeats them as shimmering, glassy echoes. It is good for ethereal textures on vocals, guitars and synths, reverse-echo effects and pitched, cascading delays. SpliceValue sets the slice length and DelayValue the echo time (SyncMode locks them to tempo), Pitch shifts the slices, Direction chooses forward or reverse, and Regenerate sets how long the echoes keep repeating. LowCut and HighCut filter the result, GateDuck with Threshold, Attack and Release can gate or duck the effect against the input, and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|crystallizer.name: Crystallizer

soundtoys|decapitator.about: Soundtoys Decapitator is an analog-modeled saturation and distortion plug-in with five Style settings based on classic hardware circuits. It is good for warmth and grit on drums, bass, vocals, guitars and buses, from subtle color to heavy distortion. Drive sets the amount of saturation, Style picks the character, and Punish adds a large extra boost for extreme distortion. Tone tilts the sound darker or brighter, LowCut and HighCut (with HighSlope) filter it, and LowThump adds a low-end bump; AutoGain keeps the level steady as Drive changes, Mix allows parallel saturation and OutputTrim sets the level.
soundtoys|decapitator.name: Decapitator

soundtoys|devil-loc.about: Soundtoys Devil-Loc is an extreme compressor and distortion effect based on the Shure Level-Loc, a broadcast limiter known for heavy squashing and pumping. It is good for crushed drums and room mics, aggressive vocal and bass effects, and pumping lo-fi textures. Crush sets how hard the signal is compressed and Crunch sets how much it is distorted. It is meant for obvious character rather than transparent level control.
soundtoys|devil-loc.name: Devil-Loc

soundtoys|devil-loc deluxe.about: Soundtoys Devil-Loc Deluxe is an extended version of Devil-Loc, an extreme compressor and distortion effect based on the Shure Level-Loc broadcast limiter. It is good for crushed drums and room mics, pumping effects and aggressive grit on bass, vocals and loops. Crush sets how hard it compresses and Crunch how much it distorts, Release sets how fast the compression recovers (and so how much it pumps), and Darkness is a low-pass filter that darkens the result. Mix blends the effect with the dry signal for parallel compression.
soundtoys|devil-loc deluxe.name: Devil-Loc Deluxe

soundtoys|echoboy.about: EchoBoy is a stereo delay effect that makes repeated echoes with rhythmic, filtered, and saturated character, from tight slapback to dub-like trails. It is good for vocals, drums, bass, and synths when you need space, groove, or retro echo. For common jobs, set Tempo to the project tempo if using Beats, then Echo1Mode or RhythmMode to Time or Beats. Useful times are 1/8 note, 1/4 note, or 250 to 500 msec. Use Feedback around 0.3 to 0.7, Mix 30 to 60, Saturation 3 to 12 dB, and LowCut or HighCut 0.2 to 0.6 to tame boom and sizzle. Add Groove or Feel at 0.05 to 0.10 for loose timing; RhythmMode with RhythmRepeats 4 to 8 makes patterns.
soundtoys|echoboy.name: EchoBoy

soundtoys|echoboy jr.about: EchoBoy Jr is Soundtoys' compact stereo delay that repeats the signal with studio-tape or transmitter character. Good for vocal or instrumental tails, rhythmic delays, ping-pong widening, and lo-fi repeats. Set Mix to 30-60%, Mode to Wide or Ping-Pong, Style to Studio Tape or Transmitter, and Glide On for subtle movement. Use EchoMode Beats with EchoNote 1/8 or 1/16 for tempo sync, or Time around 250-500 msec for natural tails. Start Feedback at 0.2-0.4, raise to 0.7-1.0 for longer trails, add Saturation 0-6 dB, and use LowCut/HighCut around 0.1-0.3 to tidy the repeats.
soundtoys|echoboy jr.name: EchoBoy Jr

soundtoys|effectrack.about: Soundtoys Effect Rack is a container that chains several Soundtoys effects in slots, so a combination such as saturation, filter and delay can be loaded and saved as one plug-in. It is good for building multi-effect chains from the Soundtoys effects installed. The effects in each slot are chosen inside its own interface, so the exposed parameters are mostly unassigned automation slots; Slot1_Solo to Slot6_Solo let you hear one slot on its own. Choose this only when the specific effects are set up inside the rack.
soundtoys|effectrack.name: EffectRack

soundtoys|filterfreak1.about: Soundtoys FilterFreak1 is a resonant analog-modeled filter with a single filter and modulation from an LFO, envelope or rhythm pattern. It is good for filter sweeps, auto-wah, rhythmic filter movement, and lo-fi or telephone-style filtering on synths, drums, guitars and vocals. Frequency sets the cutoff, Resonance emphasizes it, FilterShape chooses low-pass, band-pass or high-pass and FilterOrder sets the steepness. ModulationDepth and LFO Rate (with Tempo for synced rates) move the filter, InOutMode Analog adds saturation, and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|filterfreak1.name: FilterFreak1

soundtoys|filterfreak2.about: Soundtoys FilterFreak2 is a dual resonant analog-modeled filter with two filters that can run in series or parallel, plus LFO, envelope and rhythm modulation. It is good for complex filter sweeps, formant-like and vowel sounds, band-pass effects and rhythmic filter movement. Frequency1 and Frequency2, Resonance1 and Resonance2, Filter1Shape and Filter2Shape and Filter1Order and Filter2Order set the two filters, FilterRouting chooses series or parallel and FilterLink ties them together. ModulationDepth and LFO Rate (with Tempo) move the filters, InOutMode Analog adds saturation, and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|filterfreak2.name: FilterFreak2

soundtoys|little alterboy.about: Little AlterBoy is a Soundtoys stereo pitch shift plug-in that changes pitch and formant, with drive and Transpose or Robot modes. It is good for vocal comp, robot voices, pitch-shifted stabs, thickening vocals, and experimental textural FX. Pitch moves up or down in semitones from -12 to 12; Formant changes voice size from -12 to 12 and can be set independently. Drive adds grit from 0 to 10. Mix balances dry to wet from 0 to 100. ShiftMode offers Transpose for normal pitch changes or Robot for a processed effect. FormantLink Off keeps Formant independent, On ties it to Pitch. Bypass is Off by default.
soundtoys|little alterboy.name: Little AlterBoy

soundtoys|little microshift.about: Soundtoys Little MicroShift is a simplified version of MicroShift, a stereo widening and doubling effect that adds slightly pitch-shifted and delayed copies of the signal to the left and right. It is good for widening vocals, guitars and synths and making mono sources sound fuller. Style chooses one of three widening characters (I, II or III), Mix sets the amount, and InputGain sets the level going in.
soundtoys|little microshift.name: Little MicroShift

soundtoys|little plate.about: Little Plate is a Soundtoys plate reverb that adds a warm, dense studio-plate tail to audio, blending dry and wet signals. It is good for drum kits, vocals, guitars, and general mixing when you want a compact, classic plate sound instead of a huge hall. Set Mix around 50-80% for a normal send or wet channel, 100% for fully wet, and 0% to dry out. Decay defaults to 3.00; use 0.5-1.0 for tight slap, 2-4 for classic plate, and longer for a lush tail. Low Cut defaults to 20 Hz; raise it to 80-200 Hz to reduce rumble and muddiness on vocals, toms, and buses. Mod Enable defaults to Off; turn it On for subtle movement on static sounds. Bypass can toggle the effect on and off.
soundtoys|little plate.name: Little Plate

soundtoys|little primaltap.about: Soundtoys Little PrimalTap is a simplified version of PrimalTap, a model of an early digital delay with a characteristic lo-fi sound. It is good for slapback, doubling, gritty echoes and long, darkening repeats. Time sets the delay time and Adjust fine-tunes it, Multiply extends the time by 1x, 2x or 4x (at reduced quality, which darkens the repeats), and Feedback sets how many repeats there are. InputGain drives the input and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|little primaltap.name: Little PrimalTap

soundtoys|little radiator.about: Soundtoys Little Radiator is a simplified version of Radiator, a tube saturation effect modeled on a vintage tube mixer. It is good for warmth, thickness and gentle to heavy tube grit on drums, bass, vocals and synths. Heat sets the amount of drive, Bias changes the tube character, and Noise adds the hardware's hum and noise. Mix blends the saturated and dry signals.
soundtoys|little radiator.name: Little Radiator

soundtoys|microshift.about: Soundtoys MicroShift is a stereo widening and doubling effect, modeled on classic hardware pitch-shift widening tricks, that adds slightly detuned and delayed copies of the signal to the left and right. It is good for widening and thickening vocals, guitars and synths, and making mono sources sound bigger. Style picks one of three widening characters, Detune sets the pitch difference and Delay the timing offset, and Focus keeps the effect out of the low end so bass stays centered. Mix sets the amount.
soundtoys|microshift.name: MicroShift

soundtoys|panman.about: Soundtoys PanMan is a rhythmic auto-panner that moves sound across the stereo field using LFO, envelope, rhythm or manual triggering. It is good for adding stereo movement to synths, guitars, percussion and effects, from slow sweeps to tempo-synced bounces. Rate (with Tempo) sets the speed, Width sets how far the sound moves and Offset where it is centered, Smoothing sets how sharp the moves are, and Groove and Feel add swing. InOutMode Analog adds saturation and Mix sets the amount.
soundtoys|panman.name: PanMan

soundtoys|phasemistress.about: Soundtoys PhaseMistress is an analog-modeled phaser with many Style options based on classic phaser hardware. It is good for phasing on guitars, keys, synths and drum loops, from subtle swirl to deep resonant sweeps. Style chooses the phaser character, Frequency sets the center of the sweep, Resonance its intensity, and ModulationDepth and LFO Rate (with Tempo for synced movement) set how far and how fast it moves. InOutMode Analog adds saturation and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|phasemistress.name: PhaseMistress

soundtoys|primaltap.about: Soundtoys PrimalTap is a model of an early digital delay with two delay taps (A and B), feedback, filtering and a freeze function, known for gritty, lo-fi repeats. It is good for slapback, doubling, ping-pong and dark, degrading echoes. Time_A and Time_B (or Beats_A and Beats_B via the Sync modes) set the taps, Feedback_A and Feedback_B their repeats, and Multiply extends delay time at lower quality, which darkens the sound. Algorithm sets how the taps are routed, VCO_Depth and VCO_Rate add pitch wobble, Freeze holds the current buffer, High_Cut and Low_Cut filter the repeats, and Mix sets the blend.
soundtoys|primaltap.name: PrimalTap

soundtoys|radiator.about: Soundtoys Radiator is an amp-style distortion effect that pushes the input into warm saturation and colors it with simple bass/treble EQ and optional amp noise. It is good for gritting guitars, drums, synths, and voices, adding vintage drive, thickening thin sounds, or creating lo-fi texture. MicLine: LINE for normal signals, MIC to increase drive. Input: raise toward +3 to +6 dB for heavier distortion or lower toward -3 dB for lighter color. Bass: boost or cut low end around -3 to +3 dB. Treble: shape highs around -3 to +3 dB. Mix: 15 to 30% for subtle, 70 to 100% for full effect. Noise: On for vintage hum, Off for clean. Output: trim near 0 dB or reduce -3 to 0 dB to avoid clipping. Bypass: Off to enable.
soundtoys|radiator.name: Radiator

soundtoys|sie-q.about: Sie-Q is a Soundtoys stereo EQ and distortion plug-in that shapes low, mid, and high tonal balance and can add grit when Drive is raised. It is good for quickly balancing vocals, guitars, drums, and dialogue, adding presence or warmth, taming harshness, and injecting gentle saturation without a separate distortion unit. Use Bypass to compare settings. Low Gain adds or reduces sub warmth; keep it near 0 dB, try +3 to +6 dB for body or -3 dB if muddy. Mid Frequency selects the target area; 1.5 kHz is a vocal/instrument presence centre, lower around 0.7 kHz for honk. Mid Gain is best used sparingly, -4 to +4 dB, because its range is limited. High Gain adds air or cuts fizz, often -3 to +5 dB. Drive should start at 0 dB, then 2 to 6 dB for subtle coloration or 8 to 12 dB for more audible crunch.
soundtoys|sie-q.name: Sie-Q

soundtoys|tremolator.about: Soundtoys Tremolator is a stereo modulation effect that tremolos the signal's volume, adding rhythmic pulses, analog coloring, and optional gating. It is good for vintage tremolo on guitars and basses, rhythmic pulsing, wobble, and gated textural passages. Use Depth for amount, with 0.50 to 1.00 for strong tremolo. Set Tempo to 90 to 140 bpm for classic speeds, and set Groove and Feel to small values, about -0.10 to 0.10, for humanized timing. Choose InOutMode Analog for saturated character. For envelope or gate shapes, set EnvMode to Envelope or Gate, with Threshold -50 to -25 dB, Attack 50 to 300 msec, and Release 100 to 500 msec. Use Accent, Width, RateMod, and DepthMod to adjust the tremolo's feel, and use InputGain and OutputGain to match level.
soundtoys|tremolator.name: Tremolator

steinberg media technologies|spectralaye.about: SpectraLayers is Steinberg's ARA plug-in for spectral editing and restoration, letting you inspect and repair audio in the frequency and time domain rather than applying a continuous real-time effect. It is good for removing clicks, hum, broadband noise, reverb tails, or stray unwanted sounds from a selected region, and for careful cleanup of stems or mixed elements. This catalogue entry exposes no parameters, so there are no parameter names or settings to choose for common jobs; use the stereo input and output path and perform the edit inside SpectraLayers' ARA interface. If the host offers only bypass or no editable controls, treat it as a restoration and editing tool rather than a mix effect.
steinberg media technologies|spectralaye.name: SpectraLayers

surreal machines|diffuse.about: Surreal Machines Diffuse is a modulated diffusion delay that smears echoes into each other, from clean repeats to washy, reverb-like tails. It is good for ambient delays, spacious vocals and guitars, and dub-style echoes that blur into texture. Repeat Time (or Repeat Beats with Sync) and Regeneration set the echoes, Diffuse Size and Diffuse Amount control how much they smear, and Hi Damp Freq, Hi Damp Gain, Lo Damp Freq and Lo Damp Gain shape their tone. Mod Amount adds movement, Repeat Pattern changes the stereo pattern, Hold freezes the repeats, and Mix sets the blend.
surreal machines|diffuse.name: Diffuse

tal-togu audio line|tal-vocoder-2.about: TAL-Vocoder-2 is a vocoder modeled on vintage hardware vocoders, which imposes the spectrum of the input (usually a voice) onto a built-in carrier synth played via MIDI. It is good for classic robot voices, talking synths and vocoded pads. The input is the modulator; the carrier comes from the internal synth (sawvolume, pulsevolume, noisevolume and suboscvolume with their tuning controls) or, when sidechain is on, from a sidechain input. vocoderband00 to vocoderband10 set the level of each band, esserintensity keeps consonants audible, harmonics adds brightness, and portamento, polymode and enveloperelease shape how the notes play.
tal-togu audio line|tal-vocoder-2.name: TAL-Vocoder-2

torqwave|chorus.about: Torqwave Chorus is a built-in modulation effect that adds a slightly delayed, pitch-modulated copy of the stereo input, making voices and instruments sound wider, thicker, or gently fluttered. It is good for enriching vocals, guitars, synths, and pads without using external delay or chorus. Use Rate 0.2–1.0 Hz for musical shimmer, Delay 8–20 ms for natural chorus, Depth 3–15 ms for subtle to strong movement, Feedback around 0 to 0.4 for extra thickness or negative values for phase coloring, Mix 30–70% for a blend, and Stereo Spread 45–120° for a wide but stable stereo image.
torqwave|chorus.name: Chorus

torqwave|compressor.about: Torqwave Compressor is a built-in stereo compressor that lowers the level of passages above a chosen Threshold, smoothing peaks and bringing quiet and loud parts closer together. It is useful for taming vocals, drums, bass and dialogue, or adding gentle glue to a mix. Start with Ratio 2:1 for subtle and 4:1 for moderate control, lower Threshold until only the peaks are reduced, and use Knee for smoother onset. Attack around 10 ms suits most sources; slower attack lets drum transients through, faster attack catches quick peaks, and Release around 100 ms is a safe start.
